programme.desc: 學生用膳怕高消費，不如自行煮個「呃like學生餐」，帶返學校炫耀一番！把海中蝦截入獅子狗內一同炸，味道如何？炒飯加茄汁，或者未夠吸引，將炒飯放入蛋皮及紫菜卷內，吸引力暴升！棉花糖、牛油及脆脆米，可怎樣融合成可愛甜品？學生追求均衡營養，肥媽有甚麼方法令他們樂意享用飯後果？常被標籤為淡而無味的豆腐，與芝士及麵包糠混和，炸成「豆腐芝士球」，竟能令人感覺像吃薯仔球，輕易解決學童挑食問題！.

programme.title: 流行都市[粵]
programme.desc: 眼睛結膜負責分泌淚水黏液，保護眼睛。隨着老化，可能會患上結膜鬆弛症，出現眼睛有異物感、多眼水等不適狀況，眼科醫生細說診治資訊。張與辰將於聖誕舉行音樂會，更邀得外國才藝比賽冠軍唱將合作，二人如何越洋籌備演出？與辰自小受母親薰陶，三歲已愛上唱歌，還透露若非當初參加《中年好聲音3》，或已放棄音樂！他又暢談創作自家IP角色的靈感來源，更不忘以此行善，回饋社會。「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓示範「黑白高纖蝦球」。.

programme.title: LAW霸女神[粵]
programme.desc: 向「女神」示愛要顯誠意，在沙灘舉牌、點蠟燭加吹牧童笛；開太陽傘、用貝殼砌心心，原來上述好些舉動屬犯法？嘉賓馮盈盈答題前，笑言祖儀演女神不合常理！不少人喜歡帶寵物周圍去，但有些動物不能帶進郊野公園。盈盈以寵物可愛度作準則，想法夠獨特！手信不可亂買，花旗參、水煙壺、半熟蛋中，攜帶哪些入境香港會違法？每逢假日，許多市民都到公園紮營享受悠閒樂，竟隨時觸犯法例？有做功課的嘉慧獲森美點名稱讚，即緊張到口窒…….

programme.title: 大帥哥#3[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 天嬌、艾妞爭相討好狄奇，沅婉則悄悄離開大帥府。革命黨頭目梁政清希望沅婉留在狄奇身邊，伺機行動。沅婉回大帥府途中被先根抓去，並困在地雷陣內，狄奇不理勸阻冒險救她！狄奇率眾到鎮中收貢品，並讓妻妾揀選店舖收取進貢，沅婉堅拒選店。馬炭認定沅婉接近狄奇必有企圖，利用鎮長之女裘娸娸代筆的密函引沅婉行動，反被她戲弄。馬炭跟蹤沅婉到照相館，沅婉發現馬炭便將燒了一半的相片收入胸口。馬炭不敢造次，帶她到狄奇面前公審。.

programme.desc: 寶兒從富商身上取走銀票後，與顧井逃走，至渡頭時，寶兒棄下顧井離去。玉麟為幫承康，替忠正接下甄選「天下無雙酒」之配給人選工作。忠正從杭州回來，見玉麟與承康態度親暱，感到不是味兒，遂對承康諸多為難。忠正要與承康測試酒膽，突然發生大火，忠正依計行事從二樓跳下，安然無恙，承康突然轉身不見，正當眾人以為他貪生怕死時，卻見他抱著顧井離開火場，原來放火乃忠正出之鬼主意，但顧井卻弄假成真，眾人均不恥忠正之所為。.

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 有車輛在露天車位停泊，疑因附近大廈住戶高空擲物而受損；另一使用該停車場的車主反映有類似遭遇。堂哥夫婦經營菜檔，堂妹夫婦擔任供貨買手，雙方一直僅以口頭承諾合作。但堂哥後來稱菜檔易手，並拒絕繳付賒欠貨款。不過，堂妹發現菜檔登記人未有更改，而堂嫂亦照常於檔內打點，質疑對方故意走數……羅嘉良回歸賀TVB台慶，帶領羅天宇、游嘉欣等落力排練，盡展前輩風範。另帶來藝人參加半馬拉松賽況，以及內地野生園區旅遊情報。.

programme.title: 流行都市[粵]
programme.desc: 眼睛結膜負責分泌淚水黏液，保護眼睛。隨着老化，可能會患上結膜鬆弛症，出現眼睛有異物感、多眼水等不適狀況，眼科醫生細說診治資訊。張與辰將於聖誕舉行音樂會，更邀得外國才藝比賽冠軍唱將合作，二人如何越洋籌備演出？與辰自小受母親薰陶，三歲已愛上唱歌，還透露若非當初參加《中年好聲音3》，或已放棄音樂！他又暢談創作自家IP角色的靈感來源，更不忘以此行善，回饋社會。「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓示範「黑白高纖蝦球」。.

programme.title: LAW霸女神[粵]
programme.desc: 向「女神」示愛要顯誠意，在沙灘舉牌、點蠟燭加吹牧童笛；開太陽傘、用貝殼砌心心，原來上述好些舉動屬犯法？嘉賓馮盈盈答題前，笑言祖儀演女神不合常理！不少人喜歡帶寵物周圍去，但有些動物不能帶進郊野公園。盈盈以寵物可愛度作準則，想法夠獨特！手信不可亂買，花旗參、水煙壺、半熟蛋中，攜帶哪些入境香港會違法？每逢假日，許多市民都到公園紮營享受悠閒樂，竟隨時觸犯法例？有做功課的嘉慧獲森美點名稱讚，即緊張到口窒…….

programme.title: 大帥哥#3[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 天嬌、艾妞爭相討好狄奇，沅婉則悄悄離開大帥府。革命黨頭目梁政清希望沅婉留在狄奇身邊，伺機行動。沅婉回大帥府途中被先根抓去，並困在地雷陣內，狄奇不理勸阻冒險救她！狄奇率眾到鎮中收貢品，並讓妻妾揀選店舖收取進貢，沅婉堅拒選店。馬炭認定沅婉接近狄奇必有企圖，利用鎮長之女裘娸娸代筆的密函引沅婉行動，反被她戲弄。馬炭跟蹤沅婉到照相館，沅婉發現馬炭便將燒了一半的相片收入胸口。馬炭不敢造次，帶她到狄奇面前公審。.

programme.title: 高朋滿座#227[粵]
programme.desc: 大年初三，眾人為避免三到高家打麻將「出術」的慣例，特意躲起來，但三使出「暗渡陳倉」之計，跟義及花到高家。三跟眾人打牌時，用盡方法，甚至迫有義「鬆章」，令她得以大贏。眾人叫苦連天，唯有急召喜回家對付三。.

programme.title: 玉樓春#41[粵/普]
programme.desc: 少春揭穿來者非李太醫真正妻兒，求得三日時間調查，卻被賈逢源反擒，映雪暗中相救後自盡而亡。孫貴妃重獲清白，但心灰意冷的她決意以後吃齋唸佛。梁京冠指當年孫遜害死少春父親，少春不信，但要用自己方法查明真相。.

programme.title: 香港早晨[粵] 及 交通消息[粵]
香港早晨[粵] 及 交通消息[粵]
香港早晨[粵] 及 交通消息[粵]
方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機[粵]
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 航向未來[粵]
高朋滿座#228[粵]
programme.desc: 眾人拆利是買心頭好，義想購買名牌袋，但無耐將利是錢交給花處理。義與溢午膳，被年輕人拿出名牌袋來恥笑。義不忿，帶兩人到二手店「欣賞」自己曾擁有的手袋，卻被花賣到二手店。突然一富太衝入店中，要買下該手袋。.

programme.title: 玉樓春#42[粵/普][PG]
programme.desc: 少春用計查探孫遜無果，反被孫遜發現，帶她去水庫，在那裡少春見到孫遜深受百姓愛戴。梁京冠被發現私藏貪污金銀，孫遜受命審理此案。少春救出被孫遜綁架的常嬤嬤三人，三人卻中毒而亡。少春混入宮中想方設法報仇。.

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條[粵]
阿媽教落食平D[粵]
programme.desc: 誰說減肥要少吃肉及煎炸物？只要食材健康，食油份量控制得宜，各位視減肥為終身職業的OL，煎餅、漢堡扒照食可也！半個高麗菜混入麵粉、雞蛋、蝦乾，慢火煎出外脆內軟的「高麗菜煎餅」；混和牛油果、雞肉、麵包糠，煎出不邪惡的「牛油果雞肉漢堡」，煎煮時六號又有甚麼「蝦碌事」發生？肥媽分享蒸水蛋秘訣，在於一盒滑豆腐，它與滑蛋的結合，大家食用時小心別噎着！肥媽還教大家自製鰻魚汁及「照燒鰻魚」，滋味無窮。.

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG M\u0026G英卓及中銀香港 投資新靈感[粵]
流行都市[粵]
programme.desc: 雙手運用得多，可能出現勞損以至退化問題，骨科醫生列舉幾種常見問題，如忽視或會引致部份功能永久喪失。醫生大多會按患者情況先做保守治療，再嚴重才考慮施手術，也指出復康後物理治療的重要性。現時的母親大多都身兼數職，演員兼餅店老闆湯怡可謂其中一位強人媽媽。女兒將踏入小學新階段，有何準備？她亦分享決定開舖做生意的動力，並展示親自製作的蛋糕成品。「睇餸食飯」，關志剛師傅奉上一道「鮮蝦欖菜菜脯煎蛋角」。.

programme.title: LAW霸女神[粵]
programme.desc: 陳曉華「美貌與智慧並重」，前來競答法律知識，竟成為四題全錯第一人！腳底按摩店沒申領牌照下，提供全身按摩服務，涉違法與否跟技師和顧客的性別有關？曉華也提到近日曾做拔罐，卻連提供服務者的性別都記錯……騎三輪車要遵守法例，無戴頭盔、載貨、載客之中，哪項會犯法？嘉慧直言《東張西望》報道過，對答案充滿信心！網上轉售紅館演唱會門票牟利，並在表演場地交收，原來「場地」是關鍵。至於街頭表演唱歌，又可會是合法活動？.

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG M\u0026G英卓及中銀香港 投資新靈感[粵]
大帥哥#4[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 狄奇用槍指向自己，要求沅婉解釋，沅婉拿出照片說原委，令狄奇等釋疑。先根的地雷陣炸傷鎮民，沅婉奮不顧身救人，吸引帶病鎮民爭相來看病，狄奇順水推舟勸沅婉在雜崩冷館插旗開醫護站。先根揚言有秘密武器取得昇威鎮，隨後派人去擲臭彈。狄奇到軍營點兵抗敵，驚見只有寥寥幾個老弱殘兵。先根與軍師顧落蘆兵圍昇威鎮，聲稱願意提供除臭劑，伺機攻鎮。狄奇恫嚇對方有三千兵馬支援，急向大同取兵惜失敗，艾妞、天嬌聞言即執拾行裝…….

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機[粵]
櫻桃小丸子[粵/日]
programme.desc: 除夕當日，媽媽託小丸子去買御節料理的材料，詎料後者買了一隻伊勢龍蝦回來。小丸子被大罵一頓，不過伊勢龍蝦始終賣相一流，媽媽最終還是感謝小丸子。然而眾人吃畢龍蝦後便對御節料理失去興趣。.

programme.title: Hands Up[粵]
programme.desc: 蚌蚌公主等待多時，終於見到零食小兵出現了！四位小兵都甚精靈，於「廠長話」遊戲完成多個指令，才有人失手「中招」。蚌蚌公主快速說出連續式的指令，仍然未能分出勝負，唯有再次提升難度！兩隊於力量控制上卻遇到不少挑戰，不約而同都有地壺被大力推出，並「滑行」到界外，然而需要收集較近的食材時，力量又太小了……看清楚漢堡包圖案，找尋合適的材料，再鬥快拼砌漢堡包。有小兵每次成功通關，更會不停跳躍慶祝呢！.

programme.title: 藍色管弦樂[粵/日]
programme.desc: 曾是小提琴天才的青野一，因父親婚外情令家庭受創，決心封琴，對升學與未來亦感迷惘。一次體育課受傷，他在保健室遇上苦練小提琴的秋音律子。武田老師看出兩人的需要，安排青野指導律子，令他再次面對音樂與過去。.

programme.title: 財經新聞[粵]
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。.

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條[粵]
programme.desc: 當嚴重的抑鬱症導致大腦功能出現紊亂時，患者除情緒極度低落外，還會出現思覺失調症狀，如聽到責罵自己的幻聽，或堅信自己犯下大錯的妄想。近40歲的秀蘭，在中學時期患上抑鬱症，曾試過自殺。抑鬱症惡化時情緒低落，也會有情緒變得很高漲的時候，會不停購物，不經思索獨自去酒店住等行為，還出現思覺失調的病徵。病情斷斷續續大約8年，透過藥物與心理支援進行治療已十年沒有復發。.

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。.

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵] 及 宏利保險呈獻：灣區零距離[粵]
富途證券特約:富途講美股[粵] 及 東張西望[粵]
黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#71[粵]
programme.desc: 朱基為親近女兒圓圓，成功搬進「開心小棧」，惟圓圓刻意與他保持距離，朱基只好對外訛稱是圓圓的舅父。另一方面，朱基向龔喜坦言，與其外甥冠一拍拖的圓圓正是自己的女兒，龔喜認為二人都不應干涉這段戀情。其後，朱基發現圓圓疑似違反嘉冰訂下的規矩，為免她被扣分趕走，遂一再代她頂罪。嘉冰得悉真相後，指出朱基過分縱容，恐令圓圓他日婚後遭夫家指摘沒家教。朱基認為言之有理，決定抱着「被討厭的勇氣」，教導圓圓盡改陋習…….

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#7[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 鳳儀澄清與雲生的關係；無雙指使素希利用菲雅與德龍的合照，逼菲雅力挺家俊的網購平台項目。無雙推動電視節目《死亡揭露》的子盈專題。寶兒不顧無雙反對加入天誠，軟硬兼施下投靠了德龍，發現天明原來亦住在同一屋簷下。綺雲得悉鳳儀先前故意沒壓下爆料；夜裡，鳳儀遇襲……無雙說服鳳儀擔任《死亡揭露》的嘉賓，也獲雲生「開綠燈」推動節目。菲雅獲永康授權做網購平台項目的管理人；菲雅向家俊提出進行人工受孕，家俊樂意配合…….

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團[粵]
programme.desc: 不用考牌、上堂，花五百港幣就可體驗做機師？畏高的如風因製作組壓力而頂硬上，坐上小型飛機後卻展露孩子般的笑容……足料三文魚當麵食，如風解鎖味蕾新衝擊，再追加海膽蟹膏拌飯、豪華魚生蓋飯，份量有幾誇？雪嶽山隱藏高質又實惠的度假酒店，森林靚景加木系空間，勁Chill！如風玩轉四人房、招牌樹屋，即興玩落大閘遊戲？酒店餐廳主打從農場到餐桌，如風全方位療癒身心。另外，「跟風」發掘朱古力開心果麻糬雪糕的五層滋味。.

programme.title: 天喜堂天喜丸120 週年呈獻：逐玉#27[粵/普][PG]
programme.desc: 屠戶女樊長玉（田曦薇 飾）與落難侯爺謝征（張凌赫 飾）於風雪中宿命相逢，一個父母雙亡要做女戶主，一個隱姓埋名為報十七年前血仇，二人「各有目的」地演出了一場假婚真愛。.

programme.title: 娛樂頭條[粵] 及 環球新聞檔案[粵]
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。.

programme.title: 晚間新聞[粵]
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。.

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條[粵]
騙中傳奇#12[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 忠正與承康測試酒量，忠正將酒倒入外衣內之水袋，承康故意將酒推倒，忠正不知就裡，還沾沾自喜。次日，繼續測試酒品，承康說出當年與玉麟秉燭夜談，忠正醋意大發，侮辱二人。玉麟大罵忠正，更說出為忠正補鑊一事。忠正終讓玉麟接手挑選名單。玉麟挑選之名單與承康不謀而合，二人相逢恨晚。忠正與顧井到四川替顧客黃天霸驗證貨物，豈料又是驗證寶兒是否處子之身。夜深，寶兒到忠正房中，騙忠正喝下混有迷暈藥的酒。.

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。.

programme.desc: 雙手運用得多，可能出現勞損以至退化問題，骨科醫生列舉幾種常見問題，如忽視或會引致部份功能永久喪失。醫生大多會按患者情況先做保守治療，再嚴重才考慮施手術，也指出復康後物理治療的重要性。現時的母親大多都身兼數職，演員兼餅店老闆湯怡可謂其中一位強人媽媽。女兒將踏入小學新階段，有何準備？她亦分享決定開舖做生意的動力，並展示親自製作的蛋糕成品。「睇餸食飯」，關志剛師傅奉上一道「鮮蝦欖菜菜脯煎蛋角」。.

programme.title: LAW霸女神[粵]
programme.desc: 陳曉華「美貌與智慧並重」，前來競答法律知識，竟成為四題全錯第一人！腳底按摩店沒申領牌照下，提供全身按摩服務，涉違法與否跟技師和顧客的性別有關？曉華也提到近日曾做拔罐，卻連提供服務者的性別都記錯……騎三輪車要遵守法例，無戴頭盔、載貨、載客之中，哪項會犯法？嘉慧直言《東張西望》報道過，對答案充滿信心！網上轉售紅館演唱會門票牟利，並在表演場地交收，原來「場地」是關鍵。至於街頭表演唱歌，又可會是合法活動？.

programme.title: 大帥哥#4[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 狄奇用槍指向自己，要求沅婉解釋，沅婉拿出照片說原委，令狄奇等釋疑。先根的地雷陣炸傷鎮民，沅婉奮不顧身救人，吸引帶病鎮民爭相來看病，狄奇順水推舟勸沅婉在雜崩冷館插旗開醫護站。先根揚言有秘密武器取得昇威鎮，隨後派人去擲臭彈。狄奇到軍營點兵抗敵，驚見只有寥寥幾個老弱殘兵。先根與軍師顧落蘆兵圍昇威鎮，聲稱願意提供除臭劑，伺機攻鎮。狄奇恫嚇對方有三千兵馬支援，急向大同取兵惜失敗，艾妞、天嬌聞言即執拾行裝…….

programme.title: 高朋滿座#228[粵]
programme.desc: 眾人拆利是買心頭好，義想購買名牌袋，但無耐將利是錢交給花處理。義與溢午膳，被年輕人拿出名牌袋來恥笑。義不忿，帶兩人到二手店「欣賞」自己曾擁有的手袋，卻被花賣到二手店。突然一富太衝入店中，要買下該手袋。.

programme.title: 玉樓春#42[粵/普][PG]
programme.desc: 少春用計查探孫遜無果，反被孫遜發現，帶她去水庫，在那裡少春見到孫遜深受百姓愛戴。梁京冠被發現私藏貪污金銀，孫遜受命審理此案。少春救出被孫遜綁架的常嬤嬤三人，三人卻中毒而亡。少春混入宮中想方設法報仇。.

programme.title: 美女廚房[粵]
programme.desc: 美女廚師自製豬肉腸，再配上紅菜頭薯絲餅，三位美女動手才明白自家製香腸的難度，做出了三款不同形態的香腸，為評判陳奐仁、楊潮凱、謝東閔帶來截然不同的「風味」，最致命是無味，令眾男以為食到失去味覺。美女不忿分數低，利用指定食材田鰻煮出收兵的「軍糧餐」爭一口氣！有人用傳統薑蔥粉絲，有人破格用蛋芝士包着，勝負明顯。不過一道加了椰奶，像極「櫥窗展品」，令人食到嘔、食到喊，難道娘娘所派的「軍糧」都是這麼差？.

programme.title: 香港早晨[粵] 及 交通消息[粵]
香港早晨[粵] 及 交通消息[粵]
香港早晨[粵] 及 交通消息[粵]
方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機[粵]
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 航向未來[粵]
高朋滿座#229[粵]
programme.desc: 亨借醉向高麗求婚，麗稱若出現「大紅花轎」便答應。突然電視上，出現一幕「大紅花轎」片段，麗不支醉倒。翌日亨帶著聘禮來到高家「提親」，但醉醒的麗卻拒絕承認而逃亡。亨以吃來發洩，慶教亨以「排場」來感動麗。.

programme.title: 玉樓春#43[粵/普]
programme.desc: 孫遜被賜自盡，孫玉樓傷心難過，自覺再無面目面對林少春，獨自離去。柳三絕拜祭孫遜時遇到少春，勸少春去找玉樓，以免像自己一樣悔不當初。少春到處尋找玉樓。皇上召見梁京冠，一人帶著其貪墨罪證出現，梁京冠大驚。.

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門有段古[粵]
阿媽教落食平D[粵]
programme.desc: 食素不一定要「菜炒菇」、「菇炒豆」，肥媽設計素食食譜，可做出「三杯雞」及「黑椒雞扒」！肥媽會怎樣利用汁料及猴頭菇、雞髀菇的特性，令它們變成幾可亂真的「雞肉」？肥媽將一盒豆腐預先放進冰格，製成冰豆腐，連同木耳絲、冬菇、甘筍等放進湯煲中，加入豆瓣醬及陳醋，煲出一大碗「素酸辣湯」，開胃無比。肥媽準備了油麵筋、水麵筋，與馬鈴薯、番茄同煮，倒入咖喱醬及椰漿，煮出「椰汁咖喱齋」，隨時比椰汁咖喱雞更入味！.

programme.title: 流行都市[粵]
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。.

programme.title: LAW霸女神[粵]
programme.desc: 男士侍產假是法定勞工假期，但未婚爸爸能否享有相關權益？聞得嘉賓「大王」安德尊家產豐厚，女神們爭住叫Daddy……在巴士觀看成人影片，卻沒插牢耳機而影響別人。大王認為合法，祖儀竟為討好大王與答題內心交戰？如孩子貪玩誤傷他人，家長要為子女行為負上刑責？大王直言罪不致「誅九族」；森美也甚表贊同，惟被迫打對台。幼童隨父母走進異性公廁在所難免，但家長要留意孩童年齡，否則隨時犯法。總結八集得分，誰是終極女神？.

programme.title: 大帥哥#5[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 狄奇帶同少帥宴請先根，成功嚇得先根退兵。馬炭發現天嬌、艾妞意圖離開，二人砌詞狡辯，狄奇竟原諒她們。先根向記者展示遠程砲，預告三日後向昇威鎮附近試射一次。鎮民惶恐不安，紛紛離鎮，狄奇希望鎮民給予他三日時間解決，否則讓大家離開！狄奇知道大砲由落蘆設計及操作，遊說落蘆合作，遭對方狠狠拒絕。落蘆返回住所，先根認定他與狄奇私通，將他收押入牢。狄奇的反間計成功，遂派人前往劫獄，落蘆仍然不肯歸順，狄奇決定用刑。.

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機[粵]
櫻桃小丸子[粵/日]
programme.desc: 野口弄丟了笑話筆記，心情低落，適逢其生日將至，小丸子打算送禮物讓她恢復好心情。阿良表哥帶同妻子來探望小丸子一家，後者卻與姐姐吵架，阿良見狀提議四人分成兩組，各自遊玩完再集合。.

programme.title: Hands Up[粵]
programme.desc: 兒童節目《Hands Up》有「醬汁家族」成員和一眾主持，陪伴大家度過愉快時光。「Kids’ Notes」邀請不同界別人士，跟小朋友分享有趣事物；透過「勇闖小兵團」遊戲，讓孩子們快樂遊玩；運動教練引領大家「Workout 2gether」，鍛練身體；還會透過「Artspiration」，引領孩子了解藝術世界；「My Little Show」開放表演舞台，小朋友到來盡情展示才藝！.

programme.title: 藍色管弦樂[粵/日]
programme.desc: 秋音堅持學小提琴，迫使已放棄演奏的青野協助，其熱情喚醒青野對音樂的眷戀。得知秋音因替朋友出頭而受排擠後，青野向她道歉，並在教導她的過程中重新面對父親留下的陰影，逐漸找回拉琴的心意。.

programme.title: 財經新聞[粵]
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。.

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門有段古[粵]
programme.desc: 柴灣一個入伙新盤，驗樓師發現，窗邊有滲水跡象，客廳角落也發現空心磚，如何解決？.

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。.

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵] 及 有理說得清[粵]
東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。.

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#72[粵]
programme.desc: 楊帆等為床上用品品牌物色嬌小可愛女生任代言人，推廣新款枕頭。另一邊廂，文謙的太太、女幹探招積琦，又接到新的臥底任務與家人分離，甚至連兒子的入學面試也未能出席，文謙大感苦惱。范特栖與楊光驚見積琦竟在枕頭代言人候選之列，認為積琦不應為工作犧牲家庭；文謙卻支持愛妻實現當警察的夢想，並道出二人的相識經過。在范特栖與楊光鼓勵下，文謙決定正視夫妻聚少離多的問題，並想到留住積琦的方法，惟瞬間改變主意…….

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#8[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 綺雲發現自己在《玫瑰》內的戲份被改成與菲雅瓜分，震怒拒拍；雲生認為要以大局為重。綺雲不甘影后之路屢屢受阻，其父黎叔揚言為她掃除障礙。片場發生連環事故，無雙更一度被困火海。寶兒被無雙得悉她仍在香港；無雙誤以為德龍欺騙寶兒感情，寶兒唯有向無雙坦白選擇留下的原因……安安收到神秘訊息，嚇得向無雙求助，並將關於子盈的一切悉數告知。《死亡揭露》開錄，安安直指鳳儀佈局假裝子盈自殺，鳳儀現身反駁，兩人各執一詞…….

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團[粵]
programme.desc: 「跟風」，意謂跟隨一種風尚或潮流。主持杜如風看過網上平台的「百萬點擊影片」，百分百跟着片中人的蹤跡，逛遊韓國首爾的購物點、玩樂點，吃盡片內的餐廳、小店美食推介，到底百萬人看過的片段，是「呃Like」引人中伏，還是「值得一推」？如風化身「真人版鍵盤戰士」，留下超真實評語。除此之外，「跟風」亦可以有另一個意思，就是跟隨任性如風的私心推介，繼而自行創造獨特的旅程，讓觀眾也可名正言順地「跟『風』」！.

programme.title: 天喜堂天喜丸120 週年呈獻：逐玉#28[粵/普][PG]
programme.desc: 屠戶女樊長玉（田曦薇 飾）與落難侯爺謝征（張凌赫 飾）於風雪中宿命相逢，一個父母雙亡要做女戶主，一個隱姓埋名為報十七年前血仇，二人「各有目的」地演出了一場假婚真愛。.

programme.title: 娛樂頭條[粵] 及 環球新聞檔案[粵]
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。.

programme.title: 晚間新聞[粵]
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。.

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門有段古[粵]
騙中傳奇#13[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 忠正一覺醒來，發現寶兒睡在身旁，大驚。寶兒威脅忠正勿破壞她的搵錢大計，更要正忠正協助她偷龍轉鳳，令天霸以為巳佔有了寶兒。寶兒帶同天霸給與的三萬兩逃走，更偷下其玉佩，又令天霸知悉忠正乃幫兇，顧井為救忠正，不惜喝下毒酒。顧井毒氣攻心，九斤二關懷之情溢於言表。承康提出用三蒸三釀方法，讓顧井體內毒素流出，忠正手忙腳亂，被玉麟趕出門外，經過不斷浸浴，顧井終好轉。玉麟迫忠正說出事發經過，忠正唯有和盤托出。.

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。.

programme.title: 玉樓春#43[粵/普]
programme.desc: 孫遜被賜自盡，孫玉樓傷心難過，自覺再無面目面對林少春，獨自離去。柳三絕拜祭孫遜時遇到少春，勸少春去找玉樓，以免像自己一樣悔不當初。少春到處尋找玉樓。皇上召見梁京冠，一人帶著其貪墨罪證出現，梁京冠大驚。.

programme.title: Sunday好戲王[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 在重量級評判高志森導演面前，陳彥行、魯振順、陳柏宇、黃心穎互鬥「戲功」。「我係大話精」，眾嘉賓一起「腳浸冰水」，但只有一人真正「如履薄冰」，高導演一口咬定魯振順「扮晒嘢」，究竟看出甚麼破綻？「扮Friend食老虎」，「扮Friend者」極速洞悉「Friend底」主角，但同枱對手均非善男信女；經過連番妙語及「大爆秘密」，豐富獎品花落誰家？今集還請來泰臣送上精采「獨腳戲」，並有「黑幫王」演員分享趣事。.

programme.desc: Su-hong and his 3 Afterlife Guardians journey through 7 hells in order for all them to be reincarnated, while a household god defies all rules to help ordinary people in the living world. And the afterlife guardian's tragic lives on earth thousand years ago are uncovered one by one during their battle against the god in human world.

programme.title: Don't Go Breaking My Heart
programme.desc: Yen is a single girl from mainland working in an IT company in Hong Kong. Overwhelmed by the hustle and bustle of this sleepless city, she feels increasingly like a fish out of water. Until she meets a handsome hunk, Sean and an elite architect, Kevin. Yen is no longer alone and lonely, but will she be able to find her true love.

programme.title: Turning Point
programme.desc: Brother Laughing is supposedly an undercover police officer who has infiltrated a triad organization. During a drug-trafficking operation he is caused by Superintendent Poon. Before he became a police officer, Brother Laughing was a member of the triads and worked for the big boss man No. 1. No. 1 was very good to Laughing, and Laughing looked up to No. 1 as his elder brother. In order to strengthen his business and illegal activities, No. 1 arranges for Laughing to join the Police Force and become his mole to gather information about the plans and counter-plans for operations by the police. Laughing graduated from Police Academy with outstanding results but before he was assigned to a post as a police officer, his “bad boy” image attracted the attention of the Head of District Anti-Triad Squad, Superintendent Sin who arranges his assignment as an undercover cop to infiltrate the mob syndicate. Laughing was now a “double” mole. No. 1 was happy with this turn of events as Laug.

programme.title: My Missing Valentine
programme.desc: Hajime is a handsome young man, who is always a second quicker than everyone else. He works at the post office, where Reika comes to buy a stamp every day. Reika is a young woman, who is always a second slower than everyone else. On the day after Valentine's Day, Hajime wakes up to find himself losing all his memories from the previous day... A remake of the Best Film Winner at the Taipei Golden Horse Awards, My Missing Valentine, and relocating the story to Kyoto, the film tells a quirky romance caught in unexpected time differences.

programme.title: A Beautiful Moment
programme.desc: An ageing bachelor playboy finally meets the girl of his dreams and proposes marriage, only to discover her psychologist stepmom was his first love long ago. The future in-laws initially pretend not to know each other but as the wedding date gets nearer, the rekindling of long-dormant feelings develops into a cross-generational love triangle.

programme.title: Baogu Produces
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: The year is 1995. Mangya, a northwestern border town has become a ghost town since the once-prosperous mine and border trades shut down. The town has become an island, isolated from the outside world. There is only one police station with three police officers and one gun. XIA Ran, a retired soldier has spent over a decade here. There's a saying that he's the last survivor of the battlefield but he never talk about his story. Sandstorms hit the town once a year, and a catastrophic, once-in-decade sandstorm is forecasted for this year. The storm looms on the horizon; the final transport out of town has long left. In the dead of night, five corpses are tossed into the oil tank in the town's sole gas station. The piercing silence is interrupted by a pack of uninvited guests. However, what frightens XIA Ran more than the murders is that the gas station's tank has been emptied and the town's phone line has been severed. As the sandstorm closes in on Mangya, he realizes that everyo.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: One rainy night, the dead body of a girl, the only daughter of Hong Kong police Yin Lok, is found in the wild. Polices based on clues, suspect has been identified. However, several more girls are murdered and murder cases keep happening. Yin begins to investigate his daughter's death and met a mentally retarded girls, he is looking for more clues from this special girl. Finally, Yin is getting closer to the truth..

programme.title: MY WORST NEIGHBOR
programme.desc: Flirting with a wall between them! Seung-jin wants to become a singer, so he's preparing for a TV audition program. It's his first night at his new place. He suddenly hears a woman's ghostly wails! It turns out that Seung-jin's next door neighbor, Ra-ni has been driving people away from this apartment because of the super-thin walls! But Seung-jin won't go without a fight! After a battle of loud noises, they decide to take turns being noisy. They don't know each other's names or faces. But as they share their lives, they start to develop strange feelings for each other... The thin walls force them to share everything with each other. It's a brand new kind of romance.

programme.title: Baogu Produces
programme.desc: Sho Miyake, the Japanese director of Small, Slow but Steady, has showed up in Hong Kong to promote and present this ‘hushed' boxing film to the audience face-to-face. What is the meaning within his film? And how he made use of sound arrangements in order to allow audience experience a world like the main character of hearing-impaired does? In this episode, he will also reveal his reason of using 16mm film so that had repetitive takes avoided by actor in this work.

programme.title: Small, Slow but Steady
programme.desc: Despite battling lifelong deafness, Keiko has managed to turn pro and obtain a winning record. But as her mentor faces health issues and her gym faces imminent closure due to the pandemic, Keiko finds her will to keep fighting starting to wane.

programme.title: Cat & Mouse
programme.desc: Based on the popular Chinese novel Qi Xia Wu Yi about the story of Judge Pao in the Song Dynasty and his group of heroic helpers, who together solve cases and catch criminals galore. In the original story, Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yutong, a Robin Hood figure who assists Judge Pao from the other side of the law. Their conflict experiences a modern rendition in this hilariously iconoclastic film.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Broker
programme.desc: 'Sanghyeon' is always struggling from debt, and 'Dongsu' works at a baby box facility. On a rainy night, they steal the baby 'Woosung,' who was left in the baby box, to sell him at a good price. Meanwhile, detectives were watching, and they quietly track them down to capture the crucial evidence.

programme.title: Tonkatsu DJ Agetaro
programme.desc: Agetaro is the heir to his family's long-running tonkatsu (fried pork cutlet) restaurant in Shibuya, Tokyo. He spends his days chopping cabbages and slacking off because he has nothing else better to do. One day, he goes to a dance club to deliver a bento, and is thrilled to get a chance to speak to Sonoko, the girl he secretly has a crush on. He also experiences the excitement of the dance floor grooving to the music for the first time, and is filled with an uplifting sensation that he has never felt before. To win Sonoko's heart, Agetaro decides to become the “Tonkatsu DJ”, a guy who can cook both tonkatsu and the dance floor.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Night King
programme.desc: The year is 2012. The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club's manager, Foon, despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades. To make things worse for Foon, the club's new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife, Madame V! Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good. To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

programme.title: Don't Go Breaking My Heart 2
programme.desc: After the “Earthling” Cheung ShenRen loses Cheng Zixin to the “Martian” Fang Qihong, he decides to keep it cool and reverts to singlehood graciously. Cheng and Fang, meanwhile, live happily ever after. After jilted by Cheng, Cheung starts dating “Goddess of Stocks” Yang YangYang, who works in an opposite building. Yang has been turning a blind eye to Cheung's philandering until she meets Paul, a romantic returnee from France whose devotion has melted her heart...

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: 'I'm getting the money I'm owed, why should I prepare myself? ”Su-young, a police officer waiting to move into her dream apartment, gets entangled in an unexpected corruption case. She accepts an offer to take all the blame in exchange for a large reward. Two years later, on the day of her release from prison, the only person who comes to see her is Yoon-sun, a woman she has never met before. Su-young senses that something has gone wrong. Determined to regain everything she has lost, Su-young sets out to find Andy, who promised her the reward, but she soon encounters an even bigger and more dangerous force behind him..

programme.title: Turning Point 2
programme.desc: To undertake the ending of TV drama “Lives of Omission”, Laughing is sentenced to life-imprisonment for killing Michael. In the prison, Laughing got to know Professor Fok, an introvert serving his sentence for drug-dealing. Professor Fok is a gifted psychologist who reads mind: discovering the deepest, darkest secrets of others, thus enabling him to manipulate and control others. Laughing learns more of psychology and he holds a strong admiration for Professor Fok. But in fact, Professor Fok has an ulterior motive. Laughing, confirming his imprisonment is all part of a new secret mission, the Security Bureau wants Laughing to infiltrate in prison to investigate further for the suspected corrupted cops..

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: The world is under attack from an “Love virus”? Taek-seon is a translator who always feels tired, unmotivated and uninterested in romance. One day, Taek-seon has a disastrous blind date with Su-pil, a born single medical researcher who proposes on their first meeting. After the date they met, the world is suddenly enveloped in atmosphere of love... Taek-seon found herself laughing for no reason and searching for a beautiful dress, everything looks cute, even a daily promotional text from her old classmate Yeon-woo. However, Taek-seon knew that she had been infected with 100% fatality rate deadly virus -- Toxo Virus. She meets Dr. Lee Gyun, the only researcher who can create the antiviral medicine and she realizes that all these romantic feelings are symptoms of virus. Thus, her unexpected journey begins..

programme.title: Why me, Sweetie?
programme.desc: Ding studies drama in Beijing. One day, she helps her friend chase after her boyfriend, running vigorously on a Beijing street where she bumps into Dong. The next day, Ding visits Dong, who, strangely enough, denies their acquaintance. Dong's buddy Dr Ching diagnoses his erratic behavior as the protection mechanism of human brain. The only way to lessen the pain is to erase or repress happy memories..

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: Eddie Chan, a guilt-ridden cop trying to silence his demons from a recent shoot-out who is assigned to rescue kidnapped businessman Huang Yifei. It is a trail that leads Chan and his partner, Hung from Hong Kong to Taipei and back to Hong Kong. As the trail gets warmer, Chan begins to suspect that there are internal forces – including Hung – who seem to working against him..

programme.title: The Legend of Speed
programme.desc: After winning yet another race, the underground drag car racer king, Sky, was framed by his rival's brother Fung. On the run in Thailand, Sky hooks up with his long lost father, himself a legendary racer, who steers his son back on course for the ultimate showdown of speed with Fung.

programme.title: Stolen Love
programme.desc: Young architect Rick treats love as a game. One day, while he was checking out the poster of writer Lok Ching-I's new book, he got hit by a car..

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: Wheels On Meals
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: Tricky Business
programme.desc: Happy specializes in playing tricks, but he refuses to work for rich man Shi. By coincidence, Happy meets Moon and falls for her. However, he is not aware it is just a trick..

programme.title: Killer's Romance
programme.desc: After learning that his father was killed by the notorious Chinatown Triad, Nidaine becomes a cold-blooded killer determined to get his revenge. When one of his assassinations is witnessed by Jenny, Nidaine plans on silencing her forever. Instead, Nidaine finds himself falling for her, and they must now run for their lives from both the cops and the Triad assassins.

programme.title: Mortuary Blues
programme.desc: On a remote island off Hong Kong, its rich and happy inhabitants are celebrating an annual ritual by staging an operatic show. The island is not productive but its people are rich. No wonder police chief Yuan Kuei becomes suspicious. He thinks he is sitting on top of a narcotics ring. His two men are ordered to watch closely movement of the opera people. Little does the chief know that actually the islanders are living off the loot their ancestors made by raiding a government gold galleon some centuries ago. They buried much of the treasure and a dormant vampire under a pagoda. Two actresses and a tutor from the troupe get to the pagoda by accident, followed by the three policemen..

programme.title: The Miracle Fighters
programme.desc: Two elderly Taoist priests, Chi Men and Dun Jia, who learn their magic from the same teacher always quarrel with each other. They provide mirth and expert kung fu tuition to young man who is mistakenly presumed to be the crown prince of the Imperial Court, missing since childhood. The emperor dispatches an eunuch with the magic powers to apprehend the young man. But he must first deal with Chi Men and Dun Jia who are the young man's protector..

programme.title: The Legend of Speed
programme.desc: After winning yet another race, the underground drag car racer king, Sky, was framed by his rival's brother Fung. On the run in Thailand, Sky hooks up with his long lost father, himself a legendary racer, who steers his son back on course for the ultimate showdown of speed with Fung.

programme.title: Sea Wolves
programme.desc: As a Philippine freighter moors in Hong Kong, Gary, a man on board, assaults a Customs Officer during a routine inspection and escapes ashore. Then, a series of homicides occur near the pier. The killer's identity and motive remain a mystery until Inspector Yeung is assigned to investigate the case and links it to Gary. Acting on a tip-off that Gary is hiding in a prostitute's home, Yeung tries to trap him, but the polices also arrest the Captain's brother, John..

programme.title: Wheels On Meals
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: The Yuppie Fantasia
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

programme.title: The Miracle Fighters
programme.desc: Two elderly Taoist priests, Chi Men and Dun Jia, who learn their magic from the same teacher always quarrel with each other. They provide mirth and expert kung fu tuition to young man who is mistakenly presumed to be the crown prince of the Imperial Court, missing since childhood. The emperor dispatches an eunuch with the magic powers to apprehend the young man. But he must first deal with Chi Men and Dun Jia who are the young man's protector..

programme.title: Burning Paradise
programme.desc: Rumors have it that the Shaolin Temple is harbouring revolutionaries. The emperor believes the rumors and decides to wipe out the temple. Fong Sai-yuk escapes with his uncle to the desert. There they run into Tou Tou. Yuk's uncle is killed by the king's general, and Tou and Yuk are captured. They are taken to the Red Lotus Temple; the temple is run by Elder Kung. Hung Hei Koon, has already joined Elder Kung and voluntarily becomes his protege. Yuk looks for every chance to escape but is stopped by Koon and Koon is just pretending to have joined Elder Kung. With Koon's help, Yuk finally defeats Elder Kung..

programme.title: Dances With Dragon
programme.desc: Aaron, a young, successful businessman, drifts on to a rural island after a scuba accident. Mistaken for an illegal immigrant, he is forced to take refuge in a small, family-run grocery store. Enjoying the riches to rags transition, he tells nobody his true identity, and falls in love with the grocery store owner's daughter, Yvonne. But while Aaron enjoys his life of anonymity, Yvonne covets the chance to escape her poverty.

programme.title: Keep On Dancing
programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Buck trails two suspicious men and jumps into action to foil their plans. Soon after he meets Liu, who convinces Buck that he may be the long-lost son of a rich korean businessman..

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: Knockabout
programme.desc: Little John and brother Big John make a living out of crooked exploits and swindling. Their tricks turn sour and they find themselves stripped of cash with nowhere to turn. Desperate for protection, they scurry under the wings of mysterious master, only to pay a heavy price when they discover their master is a con man with a violent past..

programme.title: Deadly Dream Woman
programme.desc: Wong Ngung wants to help her adoptive father Yip Lei-yam to eradicate Lui Pao, an evildoer in the gang. But Lui Pao forestalls them; Yip and his daughter Mocking Bird are killed, and Wong loses her memory by a big hit. A sorceress and a girl Ah Ching save her. The two women think that Wong is a rich girl, so they treat her very well and hope for repayment. Ah Ching is in love with Ah Kat, a car-repairing worker. Her mother opposes it. Her mother also bears a great debt because of gambling.

programme.title: The Yuppie Fantasia
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

programme.title: Once upon a time in Triad Society
programme.desc: As the triad boss Lek-kuen is dying after being shot, he remembers how he became a triad member. Under the influence of Brethen Sheung-yee, Lek-kuen joined the triad society. Yet, Lek-kuen is so kind in nature that his superior and colleagues always betray him. He escapes to Japan but is still attacked by enemies, embroiling his wife Wooden Cart Noodle being killed. Afterwards, Lek-kuen becomes the worst guy among the triad members. At this moment, the story returns to the space-time when Lek-kuen is dying. In fact, he trumps up the mentioned story. The truth is that Lek-kuen does all kinds of evil but he survives from assassination. During the tussle between the Japanese triads and Hong Kong police, Lek-kuen is saved by a mysterious lady. Nevertheless, he is finally shot dead though nobody knows who the murderer is..

programme.title: Armour Of God II
programme.desc: Jackie the Condor is having his adventures, and Baron calls on him for help. Baron gives him an assistant scholar Ada, to locate and take back the gold hidden by the Nazis.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China II
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A member of the Flying Tiger Squad, Sing, is sent to school as an undercover cop to find the Commissioner's lost gun. To Sing, school is nowhere better than jail. He is suffering until he comes across the school teacher Miss Ho. Sing's school life is thus painted with more colours. Finally, Sing settles every problem and succeeds in finding the lost gun. At the Same Time, he destorys a munition smuggling activity. This leads the smugglers to school to take revenge. A group of students is being kept hostage. Sing shows his true colour by saving all the students. This not only wins his students' admiration but also Miss Ho's heart.

programme.title: Knockabout
programme.desc: Little John and brother Big John make a living out of crooked exploits and swindling. Their tricks turn sour and they find themselves stripped of cash with nowhere to turn. Desperate for protection, they scurry under the wings of mysterious master, only to pay a heavy price when they discover their master is a con man with a violent past..

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. Chi-to's cousin, Chan, acts as a go-between and arranges a trafficking of counterfeit U.S. notes between Chi-to's group and the local triad society in Taipei. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. At the ambush, police injure Lucky and arrest him, while the rest have a narrow escape and land on a boat back to Hong Kong. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky..

programme.title: You're OK, I'm OK
programme.desc: Twenty-five year old Liang Shao Chiang leads a boring life working as an auditor in a big finance corporation. He only has eyes for the receptionist Chow Yun-Lan. Chow is young and pretty, and is the natural target for the bunch of horny men around her. But she is pert and secretive, and no one is able to get even a date from her. Liang has fallen deeper and deeper for Chow. Alas this love is not reciprocative. But suddenly there is a breakthrough in his career, for four managers of the company is recommending a promotion for him! Of course, there is a price behind this - Liang has to let them use his bachelor apartment for conducting love affairs! Soon this scandal travels to the ears of the general manager Mr. Lui..

programme.title: The Haunted Cop Shop
programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.

programme.title: Para Para Sakura
programme.desc: Phillip Wong, a colour-blind dance instructor who is devoted to the Japanese Para Para. He meets Yee, a spoiled rich girl and an attraction begins to form between the two..

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: The Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Young Leong Tsan is nothing but a spoilt brat. He hates books and conventions but dotes on martial arts. His rich father loves him so much that handsome payments are awarded people who manage to lose gracefully to the son. Young Leong comes to think he is the best in Canton. A female impersonator, Yee Tai, rebuffs the amorous advances of one of Leong's friends. Leong comes to even the score, only to be defeated soundly by Yee Tai. Realizing that he is after all not good in kung fu, Leong stays behind with Yee Tai's operatic troupe as a coolie, hoping that Yee Tai would teach him the combat art some day..

programme.title: Murder
programme.desc: When Yau argues with his wife Jessica for the uneven share of dirty money, he shoots her in coma. To find out the money, Yau hires Sister Ma to look after her..

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China II
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: The Movie Star Says
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: Heart Against Hearts
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex and Chu Lai Ngo, played by George Lam and Do Do Cheng, finally get married and live with Chu's daughter Vivian, played by Vivian Chow. Since the owner of the advertising company migrates, Alex starts to take control of the company. However, the company is forced to close down due to the banker goes bankrupt. Besides, Chu and Vivian both join a financial investment company owned by Alex's old classmate ET, acted by Paul Chun. Chu is promoted to be the Assistant of General Manager in a short period of time. Nevertheless, it is a fraud for Chu. Can Alex save his company from closing down and how does Alex help Chu run away from the fraud..

programme.title: Market Wrap
programme.desc: Wrap up the day's stock market and prepare for tomorrow's trade.

programme.title: Now News

programme.title: The Heart 2
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”.

programme.title: Adrift In Love
programme.desc: 侯文詠原著小說改編，兩段糾結的情感，交織出一場關於「選擇」的情愛旅程.

programme.title: Warm on a Cold Night
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事.

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹.

programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事.

programme.title: Who is the Murderer
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁.

programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁.

programme.title: Adrift In Love
programme.desc: 侯文詠原著小說改編，兩段糾結的情感，交織出一場關於「選擇」的情愛旅程.

Sing! Asia
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演.

programme.title: Perfect Match Season 16
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: She Is the Phoenix
programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道.

programme.title: Flying Up Without Disturb
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師.

programme.title: Talk To Your Boss: Friends Season
programme.desc: 節目全新升級，以「老友季」作為主題，把觀察樣本聚焦在情感更濃、羈絆更深的職場戰友身上，對職場上下級關系的維度進行了深度開拓；通過職場老友這一切面，去探討職場中更復雜的問題解法.

programme.title: Who's Still Standing Youth Edition Season 2
programme.desc: 張泉靈、黃聖依等擔任少年見證官，在賽制內容上進行升級，分為搶位賽、團隊輪答賽、項目挑戰賽三個環節，圍繞真實生活場景與綜合性課題，著重考驗自主探究與協作破題的綜合能力；題庫覆蓋校內學科、傳統文化、時事邏輯等多領域，讓少年們在解題中感受思考的樂趣，在挑戰中養成自主探究的習慣.

programme.title: Traditional Chinese Medicine Youth Chronicles Season 3
programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深.

programme.title: Perfect Match

programme.title: Wow The World
programme.desc: 由劉宇寧、龔俊、孫紅雷、李乃文、陳赫、陳星旭、王玉雯、歐陽娣娣組成爆笑「地球團」，沿著地球脈絡從中國出發，感受北緯40度的煙火氣，通過遊戲任務解鎖各地文化與美食，用新鮮有趣的方式，探索全世界的同頻快樂.

programme.title: Who's Still Standing Youth Edition Season 2
programme.desc: 張泉靈、黃聖依等擔任少年見證官，在賽制內容上進行升級，分為搶位賽、團隊輪答賽、項目挑戰賽三個環節，圍繞真實生活場景與綜合性課題，著重考驗自主探究與協作破題的綜合能力；題庫覆蓋校內學科、傳統文化、時事邏輯等多領域，讓少年們在解題中感受思考的樂趣，在挑戰中養成自主探究的習慣.

programme.title: Crush of Music Season 2
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台.

programme.title: Aces vs Aces Season 8
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂.

programme.title: Ready To Dance Season 2
programme.desc: 第2季邀請了來自粵港澳地區的街舞少年團參加，並由贊多、敖子逸、王晨藝、黃譽博等擔任街舞領軍人物，少年們在他們的帶領下，分別進行初舞台、合作舞台以及最終的留名舞台三個階段的挑戰，通過動感的音樂和充滿激情的舞蹈，將中國傳統文化特色與街舞文化相結合.

programme.title: She Is the Phoenix
programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport
programme.desc: An Australian Outback Adventure. Tom Curtain is a professional horse trainer and Golden guitar winning singer/songwriter. He is also the founder of Katherine Outback Experience, a 90-minute horse and dog show that celebrates life in outback Australia. The show takes place at Tom’s ranch in Katherine, Northern Territory from April to the end of October, and in Pinjarra, a town in the south-west of Western Australia from November to March. It’s the end of March and it is time to go home. This will be a 4000km road trip through outback Australia.\nThe resting points are not planned but Tom and Annabel have a large web of connections on stations and showgrounds that can be called upon at last minute for a place to rest the animals. \nTravelling with 6 horses and 12 dogs, these resting spots are a place for the animals to stretch tired legs have a drink and feed. It’s an adventure they look forward to but the extreme road and weather conditions comes with its own set of challenges.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport
programme.desc: John runs Red Sun Camels in Broome, a tourist town in the north of Western Australia where visitors can experience a sunset camel ride along the famous Cable Beach. As his business expands, he needs seven more camels to add to the group, to enable his other camels to rest. But camels don’t come ready to be ridden by humans. Without extensive training they can be very dangerous, and the risk of them kicking a tourist could mean serious injury or even death. On the other side of Australia, 5000kms away, Peter has been commissioned by John to train and deliver seven wild camels. Known throughout Australia as the camel whisperer, Peter’s love of the animal is evident. Each of his seven beloved camels has a unique personality. It's a four-day transport. Due to Australia’s strict biosecurity laws, the camels have to pass a quarantine checkpoint at Kununurra, on the border of the Northern Territory and Western Australia. Clair is the government vet who will inspect each of the ani.

programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.desc: A photographer, while working on one of his assignments, comes across the backpack of a beautiful girl.

programme.title: Bhaiyya Ji
programme.desc: A man stands up for his family and seeks revenge for the wrongs done towards his loved ones.

programme.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2
programme.desc: When strangers Reet and Ruhan cross paths, their journey leads to an abandoned mansion and a dreaded spirit who has been trapped for 18 years.

programme.title: Atrangi Re
programme.desc: A Tamil boy meets a girl from Bihar, what follows is a love story for the ages. A non-linear narrative of two romances running in parallel from different timelines.

programme.title: Ramji Londonwale
programme.desc: This is the story about Ramji, who is a skilled cook and flies to London to try his luck in work. It is the story about his journey and life in London.

programme.title: Naya Raasta
programme.desc: Chander, a criminal lawyer, gives up his successful career and returns to his ancestral village. There, he comes face-to-face with social problems such as casteism, untouchability and poverty.

programme.title: Gumraah
programme.desc: The murder investigation into a young man's death takes an unexpected turn when the cops discover that the prime suspect has a lookalike.

programme.title: Extraaa Storiez Kgf: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Watch behind the scenes and meet the cast and crew of the movie.

programme.title: Nikamma
programme.desc: An unemployed carefree young man is at loggerheads with his more diligent sister-in-law. However, they must join forces to defeat a common enemy.

programme.title: Secret Superstar
programme.desc: Insia, an ambitious young girl, dreams of becoming a singer but faces opposition from her father. Undeterred, she strives to follow her passion by anonymously posting her songs on the Internet.

programme.title: Malaal
programme.desc: Two very different people from contrasting backgrounds experience the innocence of love.

programme.title: Ilzaam
programme.desc: After Aarti's father disapproves of Ajay as his future son-in-law, he suddenly disappears from her life. Years later they meet again, but Aarti is shocked to find the truth behind his disappearance.

programme.title: Kuttey
programme.desc: One rainy night in the outskirts of Mumbai, three stray gangs unknowingly cross paths on the hunt and it's every man for himself.

programme.title: Raaz
programme.desc: Sanjana and Aditya go to Ooty for a holiday to save their unsteady marriage. However, Sanjana is haunted by a spirit who reveals some dark secrets about Aditya and his past.

programme.title: Pati Patni Aur Woh - 2019 -Pati Patni Aur Woh
programme.desc: Chintu Tyagi is an ordinary, middle class man who finds himself torn between his wife and another woman.

programme.title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
programme.desc: When a masked madman who wants to destroy India steals a dangerous weapon, two elite soldiers must work together to recover it.

programme.title: Ek Chalis Ki Last Local
programme.desc: A comic thriller about two people who miss the last local train at 1:40 am and how missing of their train changes their course of life forever.

programme.title: Jaaneman
programme.desc: Suhaan, an aspiring actor, is in a fix when Piya files for divorce and forces him to pay a large amount as alimony. To avoid paying her, Suhaan uses Agastya's love for Piya and helps him woo her.

programme.title: Kashmir Ki Kali
programme.desc: A rich Man, Rajeev falls for the charms of a beautiful but poor flower seller Champa, but the pair must overcome class boundaries to find true love. Starring Sharmila Tagore and Shammi Kapoor.

programme.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2
programme.desc: When strangers Reet and Ruhan cross paths, their journey leads to an abandoned mansion and a dreaded spirit who has been trapped for 18 years.

programme.title: Azhar
programme.desc: Biographical sports drama based on the life of former Indian international cricketer, Mohammad Azharuddin. Starring Emraan Hashmi.

programme.title: Bade Dilwala
programme.desc: A man upsets his wife by splitting a winning lottery ticket with a waitress.

programme.title: Section 375
programme.desc: A filmmaker stands trial when a costume assistant on his movie accuses him of rape.

programme.title: Hit- The First Case -Hit- The First Case
programme.desc: A brilliant but troubled police inspector sets out to solve a confounding case, all while fighting to gain clarity into his troubled past.

programme.title: Soorma
programme.desc: Soorma is the story of the triumph of the human spirit, about a player, who made headlines for his miraculous comeback after facing a near death experience through sheer determination.

programme.title: Zara Hatke Zara Bachke
programme.desc: Kapil and Somya are a happily married couple who live in a joint family and decide to get a divorce. Things don't go as planned as their family gets to know of it, and thus begins a comedy of errors.

programme.title: Maidan E Jung
programme.desc: Arjun learns that his sister loves a man who is about to get married and makes efforts to unite them. But when he learns that his sister's in-laws plan to kill her, he sets out to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Double Xl
programme.desc: Two plus-size women who are body-shamed, head to London to prove that dreams matter and challenge the societal norms for beauty.

programme.title: Veerey Ki Wedding
programme.desc: Veer and Geet fall in love with each other and want to get married. However, they face an obstacle after Geet's peace-loving father sees Veer getting involved in a fight to protect a girl. Release Year: 2018 Director: Ashu Trikha.

programme.title: Ok Jaanu
programme.desc: Adi and Tara go to Mumbai, chasing dreams. They fall for each other in a carefree romance. Careers cause problems. Will their love survive their ambition? Release Year: 2017 Director: Shaad Ali.

programme.title: Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya
programme.desc: Aryan cannot find his ideal partner. He meets Sifra on a trip to the USA and falls in love with her, only to discover later that it is an impossible love affair. Release Year: 2024 Director: Amit Joshi, Aradhana Sah Awards: 23rd Zee Cine Awards: Kriti Sanon for SIFRA.

programme.title: Mission Mangal
programme.desc: Based on an extraordinary true story of India's finest scientists who rose above all the hardships and failures to make India the only country to reach Mars in its first attempt. Release Year: 2019 Director: Jagan Shakti.

programme.title: Sultan
programme.desc: Sultan Ali Khan, a former wrestler, quits after his son's death. Years later, he returns to the sport, seeking prize money and redemption, determined to reclaim his lost respect.

programme.title: Tadap
programme.desc: Ishana and Ramisa share a passionate relationship, but everything changes between them when Ramisa's father learns about their secret affair. Release Year: 2021 Director: Milan Luthria Awards: 2022 Winner IIFA Award - Best Debut Actor - Ahan Shetty, 2022 Winner Popular Award - Best Male Debut - Ahan Shetty.

programme.title: Phir Wahi Raat
programme.desc: A psychiatrist falls in love with a woman referred to him after having hallucinations and nightmares of a woman. Release Year: 1980 Director: Danny Denzongpa.

programme.title: Krishna Cottage
programme.desc: A bunch of youngsters are in a car. On their way, strange things start happening and they are forced to seek shelter in Krishna Cottage. Watch the thriller starring Sohail Khan and Isha Koppikar. Release Year: 2004 Director: Santram Varma.

programme.title: Mujhse Fraaandship Karoge
programme.desc: Preity and Vishal unknowingly connect through mistaken identities on social media, sparking funny and heartfelt conversations as they talk to their crushes using a friend's account. Release Year: 2011 Director: Nupur Asthana.

programme.title: Shikari
programme.desc: An escaped prisoner, masked as Mahendra Pratap Singh, travels to Cape Town to kill Virendra Rawal, then feigns love for Rajeshwari, vowing to erase Rawal family.

programme.title: Guru
programme.desc: Guru, a determined dreamer, leaves his small village with his wife to chase his goal of starting his own business, embracing new challenges and opportunities on the road to success.

programme.title: Kaagaz 2
programme.desc: The Struggles of a common man whose right to life is infringed upon by protests and rallies. Release Year: 2024 Director: V.K. Prakash.

programme.title: Fan
programme.desc: Gaurav's world revolves around the superstar Aryan Khanna. What happens when his passion turns into a dangerous obsession that crosses the fine line? Release Year: 2016 Director: Maneesh Sharma Awards: 2017 Winner Technical Award- Best Special Effects, 2017 Winner Technical Award- Best Makeup- Greg Cannom.

programme.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana Phir Se
programme.desc: An army officer squares off against drug lords and Russian henchmen to save his ex-lover's kidnapped daughter in the underbelly of Goa, India. Release Year: 2018 Director: Navaniat Singh.

programme.title: Ek Tha Tiger
programme.desc: Agent Tiger is sent to Dublin to observe a scientist. There he falls in love with the latter's caretaker, who is an ISI agent. Release Year: 2012 Director: Kabir Khan Awards: People's Choice Awards- Favorite Movie, Favourite Movie Actor- Salman Khan, Favourite Action Movie Star- Salman.

programme.title: Aankhen
programme.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. He trains three blind men to do the job for him. Release Year: 2002 Director: Vipul Amrutlal Shah.

programme.title: Jolly Llb 3
programme.desc: Two lawyers sharing the name Jolly-Mishra and Tyagi-lock horns in a clever courtroom showdown, using sharp wit and outrageous antics that turn legal battles into comic chaos. Release Year: 2025 Director: Subhash Kapoor Awards: 2025 Winner Surfers' Choice Award- Best Actor in a Comic Role- Arshad Warsi.

programme.title: Sanjeevani
programme.desc: Many people go in search of a mysterious plant that can bring people back to life. But, upon reaching there, they encounter strange creatures, from whom they have to run away.

programme.title: Jayeshbhai Jordaar
programme.desc: A timid Jayesh must defy his patriarchal family as he flees with his wife to save their unborn daughter from foeticide. Release Year: 2022 Director: Divyang Thakkar.

programme.title: The President Is Coming
programme.desc: Six young contestants undergo bizarre tests and stop at nothing to top the list of the young faces responsible for shaping 'The New India' and eventually meet George Bush.

programme.title: Monsoon Shootout
programme.desc: Adi, a policeman, joins an anti-extortion unit of the Mumbai Police led by Khan. When an ambush goes wrong, Adi chases a wanted gangster, Shiva. Release Year: 2013 Director: Amit Kumar.

programme.title: Jamai Raja
programme.desc: When the wealthy Durgeshwari's daughter falls in love with Raja, a poor boy, she reluctantly agrees to their union. However, she constantly tries to sabotage their relationship, but Raja outwits her. Release Year: 1990 Director: A. Kodandarami Reddy.

programme.title: Aisha
programme.desc: Aisha, who loves playing matchmaker much to her friend Arjun's disapproval, finds a new target in the simple Shefali. But in the process, she ends up ruining her own relationship with close friends. Release Year: 2010 Director: Rajshree Ojha Awards: Stardust Award for Breakthrough Performance - Female Amrita Puri.

programme.title: Mere Brother Ki Dulhan
programme.desc: A quirky Northern Indian rom-com about Kush seeking a bride for his brother, only to fall for her himself, triggering chaotic, comedic, heartwarming consequences. Release Year: 2011 Director: Ali Abbas Zafar Awards: Stardust Awards- Superstar of Tomorrow Male- Imran Khan.

programme.title: Bhoothnath Returns
programme.desc: A ghost returns from his 'Bhoothworld' where he is mocked for his inability to scare children. On Earth, he has something more to do for his country. Release Year: 2014 Director: Nitesh Tiwari Awards: National Film Awards- Special Mention- Parth Bhalerao For Killa.

programme.title: Ready
programme.desc: Prem in love with Sanjana whose uncles are behind her massive bank account. The story is about how they teach a lesson to her uncles. Release Year: 2011 Director: Anees Bazmee Awards: BIG Star Entertainment Awards 2011: Most Entertaining Film, Stardust Awards 2012: Star of the Year - Male Salman Khan, Stardust Awards 2012: Standout Performance by a Lyricist Ashish Pandit for 'Dhinka Chika'.

programme.title: Lafangey Parindey
programme.desc: After an accident leaves aspiring dancer Pinky blind, Nandan helps her rebuild her confidence. Together, they overcome challenges as she prepares to pursue her dream on a reality show. Release Year: 2010 Director: Pradeep Sarkar.

programme.title: Mujhse Dosti Karoge
programme.desc: Raj loves Tina and Pooja loves Raj. When they meet years later, he and Pooja fall in love but she rejects his marriage proposal.

programme.title: Parole
programme.desc: Two brothers, one a criminal, grow closer after their mother dies. The younger brother tries to get the older one paroled so he can perform her last rites.

programme.title: The Legend Of Michael Mishra
programme.desc: Michael Mishra, a kidnapper from Patna, falls for a girl, Varsha Shukla, at a very young age. He got arrested and sent to jail. Release Year: 2016 Director: Manish Jha.

programme.title: Anupamaa
programme.desc: Anupamaa sacrifices her ambitions for family, feeling uncredited. She finds empowerment by living on her terms after trials, showcasing a dramatic journey of resilience and independence.

programme.title: Sayoneee
programme.desc: An orphan girl Saanvi yearns for a mother's love, unaware her mother is alive. An emotional tale of separation, longing, and destiny bringing a mother-daughter duo together.

programme.title: Udne Ki Aasha
programme.desc: Sayali desires a fairytale romance, but fate intertwines her with Sachin, a complex figure. Will her dreams of a perfect life survive this unexpected connection.

programme.title: Yeh Fitoor Tera

programme.title: Goin' Bulilit S15
programme.desc: A gag show with child actors playing adult roles, doing gags, sketches and segments. Instead of playing roles based on their own age, child actors are made to portray adult characters like Doctors, Teachers, Married Couples, etc.

programme.title: TV Patrol Express
programme.desc: TV Patrol Express, hosted by Jeff Canoy and Denice Dinsay is a quick look at the top stories of the day. A fifteen minute fast-paced newscast, it offers a glimpse of breaking news, stories that developed, and updates to watch out for on TV Patrol for the on-the-go viewer.

programme.title: Got To Believe
programme.desc: Got to Believe is a romantic comedy-drama about childhood friends Chichay and Joaquin, who are separated after a tragic accident and reunited years later without realizing their shared past. As they grow closer, they face challenges involving family secrets, social differences, and personal struggles, ultimately discovering the power of love, friendship, and believing in magic.

programme.title: TV Patrol Live
programme.desc: ABS-CBN's flagship newscast and the country's leading news program in the past two decades, anchored by the most celebrated news team ever assembled in the history of Philippine broadcasting.

programme.title: Sigabo
programme.desc: The series explores the stark contrast in the lives of two individuals: Gabo (Martin), a spunky, street-smart man from a vibrant, humble community, and Samantha (Montes), a tough, fearless law enforcer from a highly affluent and privileged background. It blends action, romance, and comedy as their paths cross and their different worlds collide.

programme.title: Someone, Someday
programme.desc: Someone, Someday follows Billy (Kathryn Bernardo), the young CEO of a dating app that empowers women to find their destined true love-while secretly carrying the heartbreak that has kept her from finding her own. Driven by her unwavering love for her friends and family, especially her younger brother who she raised by herself, Billy must confront the wounds she's spent years hiding before she can reclaim her dreams-and finally discover whether someone, someday, was meant for her after all.

programme.title: The Loyalty Game
programme.desc: A wife puts her husband to a simple loyalty test, unaware she will unleash a dangerous game of seduction, secrets, and deadly deception. After a troubled night leaves Ana waking up without her husband Ben by her side, she hires Beth to test his loyalty by seducing him. The connivance between wife and loyalty tester soon turns into a dangerous, seductive psychological game of secrets, manipulation, and power play, where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: It's Showtime
programme.desc: The venue for Pinoys to strut and display their unique talents for all the world to see. Led by a powerhouse cast of popular celebrities - Vhong Navarro, Anne Curtis, Ogie Alcasid, Karylle, Jhong Hilario and Vice Ganda to name a few.

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.

programme.title: The General's Daughter
programme.desc: Rhian Bonifacio, an AFP military nurse, secretly works as a spy for the man she believes is her father, Santiago Guerrero, who has raised her to seek revenge against military general Marcial de Leon. 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 居港越南人Tracy帶伍倩彤品嚐越南地道檬粉。米紙蝦卷包裹檬粉、香菜等配料，加上秘製花生醬，酸爽開胃；蟹膏番茄湯檬鮮味濃郁，蟹膏蛋餅飽吸湯汁精華。此外，順化牛腱米線湯底鮮甜；斑蘭綠豆糕層次分明，同樣不容錯過。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到荃灣的酒店品嚐豐盛美饌。香烤拼盤包羅羊架、串燒及迷你漢堡包等惹味佳餚；特色下午茶套餐則有鴨肝西多士、芒果拿破崙等鹹甜美點，以及由區內老字號食店供應的馳名糯米糍，滋味十足。.

programme.desc: 元朗二手成交由高位回落三成，擴闊議價空間，區內較早發展的屋苑，樓價處於甚麼水平？西沙一個大型新盤，有新期數入伙，其中一個高層三房戶，附設儲物室，交樓質素能否保持？.

那年花開月正圓#27[粵/普]
programme.desc: 周瑩(孫儷 飾)意外嫁入陝西吳氏家族，新婚不久丈夫猝然離世，她陷入各種利益博弈和紛爭，但她以特有的聰慧，睿智與堅忍，在錯綜複雜的情感糾葛與家族矛盾中，用自己的方式擔起吳家大業，成就了晚清女商聖的傳奇。.

programme.title: 那年花開月正圓#28[粵/普]
programme.desc: 周瑩(孫儷 飾)意外嫁入陝西吳氏家族，新婚不久丈夫猝然離世，她陷入各種利益博弈和紛爭，但她以特有的聰慧，睿智與堅忍，在錯綜複雜的情感糾葛與家族矛盾中，用自己的方式擔起吳家大業，成就了晚清女商聖的傳奇。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 居港越南人Tracy帶伍倩彤品嚐越南地道檬粉。米紙蝦卷包裹檬粉、香菜等配料，加上秘製花生醬，酸爽開胃；蟹膏番茄湯檬鮮味濃郁，蟹膏蛋餅飽吸湯汁精華。此外，順化牛腱米線湯底鮮甜；斑蘭綠豆糕層次分明，同樣不容錯過。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到荃灣的酒店品嚐豐盛美饌。香烤拼盤包羅羊架、串燒及迷你漢堡包等惹味佳餚；特色下午茶套餐則有鴨肝西多士、芒果拿破崙等鹹甜美點，以及由區內老字號食店供應的馳名糯米糍，滋味十足。.

programme.title: 東方表行 Take Your Time 呈獻:我和牠的故事[粵] 及 航向未來[粵]
programme.desc: 馬貫東自小對貓過敏，某次與貓咪玩耍後竟沒過敏反應，從此開啟了其愛貓人生。富愛心的阿東在自家寵物美容店特設暫託空間，給待領養的貓貓一個落腳點。他更自揭考取寵物美容師執照的初衷，就是想將浪浪打扮得漂漂亮亮，提高被收養機會。阿東亦十分關注領養後續，拍攝期間，除了有心主人帶貓回來探望「娘家」，他更親自出發到另一家做家訪。「暫託爸媽物語」，俊其、泳芍終於將暫託主子帶回家中，並為貓貓準備了不同的適應新居方法。.

programme.title: 下飯江湖4 食色福州[粵/普]
programme.desc: 本集介紹福州味道的甜與鮮：荔枝肉酸甜酥脆，是夫妻小店招牌；深夜燉罐慢蒸六小時，熬出山海精華；茶香入饌，佛跳牆與貴妃蚌吃出閩菜精緻。鏡頭跟著何俊夫婦、吳阿姨母子和高峰，看福州人如何把山海滋味過成日子。.

programme.title: 紅色高踭鞋#42[粵/韓][PG] 及 航向未來[粵]
programme.desc: 賢錫不停追問基錫是否和珍瑪吵架，基錫卻要賢錫好好守護慧彬，讓賢錫一頭霧水。太吉受不了家裡的氣氛，憤憤然地說要去自首，反而讓珍瑪動怒。珍瑪跟秀燕喝酒，竟無意中得知熙瓊疑似毒死自己的婆婆，於是故意試探她….

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵]
利嘉閣地產45周年真盤源特約 :今日有樓睇[粵]
programme.desc: 天后一個1,000平方呎單位，以畫廊作靈感，同時利用對比色，營造現代風格，整體效果如何？.

programme.title: 就是愛美麗[粵/普]
programme.desc: 女人要調養內在美，才能由內而外散發自信；美容醫學專家教授婦科保養方式，還有改善鼾聲的方法。台灣國父紀念館後面有一間裝修簡約的甜品店，嘉賓蘇子芸和Minnie於內品嚐甜品，並為「愛美麗盲測」比較四款化妝水的質感、保濕度和價格。「愛美麗時尚」走訪一間時尚多元潮流選物店，不論是台灣藝人設計的品牌服飾、日本時尚新品等，應有盡有。原宿表參道有不少售賣生活雜貨的專門店，「東京時尚遊」介紹當中一個人氣品牌。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 美食KOL Arthur帶暉哥品嚐韓國「邪惡美食」。薄切牛三角刺身油脂豐腴，入口即融；醬油生醃斑馬瀨尿蝦鮮味濃郁，蝦膏甘香；牛腸鍋包含不同內臟部位，「脂味」十足；炸雞配大閘蟹粉，鮮味大增。位於荔枝角的西班牙餐廳主打該國各地特色佳餚。招牌生烤乳豬皮脆肉嫩，薯仔飽吸肉汁精華；以本地小銀魚、鮮魷及九肚魚炮製的脆炸小食極惹味；紅蝦海鮮飯集海鮮精華於一身；馬德里傳統夾肉包配烤和牛、焦糖洋蔥等配料，層次豐富。.

programme.title: 旅人視角[粵/普]
programme.desc: 台南是不少旅人的熱選地，祐宏入住當地一間簡約風格的酒店，有何特色？他及後嘗試自製手工眼鏡，並可在框架印上名字。由著名導演魏德聖開設的餐廳，內裡放滿了電影相關物品，祐宏還打聽到魏導的心水美食。他又品嚐台南地道椪糖，這款小吃更有「發財糖」的別名？貓咪咖啡店吸引許多愛貓人士「朝聖」，大家亦會點吃店內「珍珠奶茶戚風蛋糕」等滋味甜點。祐宏再到訪百年木屐店，除了款式多選擇之外，穿木屐原來能夠塑造漂亮腿型？.

programme.title: 網紅甜卡[粵] 及 警聲百二秒 IV[粵]
programme.desc: 古著是名牌以外的另類選擇，Christy、Jessica隨Veronica參觀巴黎古著專門店，穿出跨時代經典時尚，造型亮眼！三人隨即往「人氣」劇集取景地朝聖，在吊刑廣場紅色酒館、萬神殿瘋狂打卡，與當地劇迷交流；如何利用建築物的特色，拍出具電影感的美照？兩位主持另相約美食導遊訪尋隱世甜點、學捲牛角包，店主兼甜品師開店純因友情？靈感來自單車的招牌甜點、榮登食譜書封面的真正「千層」酥，「味」力沒法擋！.

programme.title: 那年花開月正圓#29[粵/普]
programme.desc: 周瑩(孫儷 飾)意外嫁入陝西吳氏家族，新婚不久丈夫猝然離世，她陷入各種利益博弈和紛爭，但她以特有的聰慧，睿智與堅忍，在錯綜複雜的情感糾葛與家族矛盾中，用自己的方式擔起吳家大業，成就了晚清女商聖的傳奇。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 星廚莫燦霖帶波波到陳佑良師傅主理的餐廳，品嚐懷舊手工粵菜。秘製生醃汁海釣鮮魷爽脆彈牙，醬汁更提鮮；胡椒豬肚鳳吞燕，將燕窩釀入起骨雞殼內，再以豬肚包裹燉製，鮮味層層交融；濃雞汁玻璃大蝦球盡顯精湛刀工，蝦球晶瑩剔透；紅棗皇糕香甜軟糯，層次豐富。施焯日帶陳若思到訪位於尖沙咀的老字號京菜館，品嚐單立文、蘇民峰師傅等名人愛吃的招牌菜，包括叉子燒餅配榨菜肉末、北京填鴨、蝦子鍋塌豆腐及蟹粉芙蓉，盡享京菜風味。.

programme.title: 下飯江湖4 食色福州[粵/普]
programme.desc: 年近60的林偉榕在福州經營小店，他的撈化價廉物美，廣受民眾歡迎；陳公一每早四點就回店裡煮鴨湯，做成醬鴨撈化，很多食客吃完就愛上；林女士在市場做肉燕30多年，一直堅持人手製作；它既簡單，又讓人難以忘懷。.

programme.title: 娛樂新聞報道
programme.desc: 每晚緊貼香港娛樂圈的消息，以至世界各地的影視娛樂新聞，報道藝人最新動態、劇集和電影宣傳、演唱會精華、頒獎禮盛況等，甚至遠赴外地採訪娛樂盛事、追蹤各地影星，專訪觀眾熟悉的歌、影、視紅人，讓大家瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈的動態和最新消息。.

programme.title: 世界第一等[粵/普]
programme.desc: 班傑和君侖繼續泰北的行程, 奮力搏鬥了半個多小時終於釣起一條一米多長的大魚；班傑當乘客, 君侖充當車夫趕著馬車遊古城體驗穿越時空的感覺；之後他們戴上頭燈跟當地人一起撿\"黃金\", 度過瘋狂又愉快的夜晚….

programme.title: 按居按揭轉介呈獻:星二代煮飯仔[粵]
programme.desc: 「小廚神」Lucy自信廚藝有五星，被母親梁志瑩揭穿僅兩次下廚經驗。Lucy偕妹妹Sucy出外買餸，想煮蒜蓉牛油蘑菇，卻差點買錯冬菇……「小助手」Sucy客串處理食材後要守規回座，反對無效下只好哭着投奔媽媽懷抱。Lucy初次一手包辦烹飪步驟，兌現「五星」功架，母親、妹妹都讚好！母女再煮薑蔥雞翼，女兒們最期待用手撈醃料？Lucy點評母親出品，「頒獎」時刻份外溫馨！加插親子問答，Lucy趣怪奉上表情包。.

programme.title: 點劇成真:降魔的#20[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 晶晶獲安排住在安全屋暫避，以防展明加害。魔出現在電視城故弄玄虛，敢當即前往與其開戰，卻處於下風。敢當後來發現自己化身成偉豪，正接受未婚妻貝娜的訪問。到婚禮舉行時，敢當冷靜下來發現魔的化身。敢當替晶晶開天眼，告知晶晶他並非豪仔的真相；晶晶哭着說自己待敢當已如親生兒子一樣。敢當要馬季拿着神石，並告知自己的靈力已愈來愈弱。馬季不斷想辦法使敢當恢復元氣，可是敢當表示他的靈力正在被馬季吸走…….

programme.title: OT無限loop
programme.desc: 每晚深夜，公司仲有邊個未收工？有屋企唔返，咁搏命係愛定係責任？閉路電視全程無間斷直擊，《社畜求生101》主角阿星同阿花捱更抵夜職場血淚史！.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 追夢無分年齡！藝人阮兆祥於十七歲參加「新秀」入行，惟歌唱發展不順，遂將重心放在主持、拍劇上。他多年來從未放棄音樂理想，最近還回歸歌手身分，推出HiFi唱片，並舉辦個人演唱會。他更藉新歌MV中的三個故事，鼓勵大家勇於追夢。主角還需綠葉扶持，祥師兄坦言能將興趣變為事業已甚難得，遂認真看待每個機會，還甘願當「二把」！但入行初期，他亦曾感迷茫，當時有何想法？他還提到每次登台前均會改編歌曲，希望帶來新鮮感。.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 出道多年的阮兆祥，未忘心中音樂夢，決意重投歌手崗位，還舉辦個人演唱會。追夢道路上，祥師兄感激身邊朋友支持，特別是妥善處理其個唱行政工作的好拍檔梅小惠，且聽他細說二人從EYT時代培養的深厚友情與默契。至於新歌MV，祥師兄大灑金錢提升製作品質，並邀得錢國偉擔任導演。縱然忙着推出一系列音樂計劃，祥師兄卻坦言享受過程。而演唱會不單精選七十年代至今的流行曲，他還透露會安排十六人樂隊助陣，進一步提升音樂效果。.

programme.desc: 年近60的林偉榕在福州經營小店，他的撈化價廉物美，廣受民眾歡迎；陳公一每早四點就回店裡煮鴨湯，做成醬鴨撈化，很多食客吃完就愛上；林女士在市場做肉燕30多年，一直堅持人手製作；它既簡單，又讓人難以忘懷。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 星廚莫燦霖帶波波到陳佑良師傅主理的餐廳，品嚐懷舊手工粵菜。秘製生醃汁海釣鮮魷爽脆彈牙，醬汁更提鮮；胡椒豬肚鳳吞燕，將燕窩釀入起骨雞殼內，再以豬肚包裹燉製，鮮味層層交融；濃雞汁玻璃大蝦球盡顯精湛刀工，蝦球晶瑩剔透；紅棗皇糕香甜軟糯，層次豐富。施焯日帶陳若思到訪位於尖沙咀的老字號京菜館，品嚐單立文、蘇民峰師傅等名人愛吃的招牌菜，包括叉子燒餅配榨菜肉末、北京填鴨、蝦子鍋塌豆腐及蟹粉芙蓉，盡享京菜風味。.

programme.title: 網紅甜卡[粵] 及 才駿HASHTAG M\u0026G英卓及中銀香港 投資新靈感[粵]
programme.desc: 法國女性時尚優雅，Christy、Jessica追尋當中不凡魅力，在Veronica引領下先到唇膏店，依個人膚色、衣著挑選不同顏色、質感、香味，打造個人專屬唇膏；再參觀香水品牌博物館，了解香水歷史，調配獨一無二專屬香水，增添女人味！兩位主持隨後拜會法國甜品網紅，學造「雲呢拿朱古力撻」，並以鏡頭捕捉甜品的誘惑，有什麼竅門？兩人又充當當地女攝影師的模特兒，在日照光影中的巴黎街頭，展現令人驚喜的靜態美。.

programme.title: 東方表行 Take Your Time 呈獻:我和牠的故事[粵] 及 航向未來[粵]
programme.desc: 樊亦敏一直也愛回家，皆因家中有三隻可愛狗狗，當中Hana和Kuma可謂「松鼠狗姐弟」，時常朝着同一方向。至於臘腸犬Fred被原主人形容「難搞」，亦敏特意由英國越洋接牠回港，望以「愛」感化。其實亦敏也有養兔，兔仔是《開心速遞》的「演員」之一，卻發覺公司環境並不適合牠，遂帶返家飼養。亦敏清楚兔仔所需，也許跟留學時一段錯失經歷有關？暫託爸媽俊其、泳芍於貓貓入屋48小時內的黃金時間，如何為牠們建立安全感？.

programme.title: 紅色高踭鞋#43[粵/韓][PG] 及 航向未來[粵]
programme.desc: 珍瑪得知熙瓊疑似毒死自己婆婆，於是故意試探她。蒙面人闖進赫相家，目的可能是要傷害人，讓赫相感到不安；熙瓊認定這件事與珍瑪有關，便跑去質問她…赫相要賢錫與珍瑪去釜山出差，遭熙瓊和慧彬反對，鬧得不可開交。.

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵]
利嘉閣地產45周年真盤源特約 :今日有樓睇[粵]
programme.desc: 荔枝角一個指標屋苑，交投由高位大跌三成，不過呎價反而升至全年高位，升勢能否持續？.

programme.title: 就是愛美麗[粵/普]
programme.desc: 潮流不只是一個趨勢，還是一種態度！關婷玉、郭源元、蘇子芸、劉璇一同分析及演繹2019春季時尚。衣服沾上紅酒污漬？外套拉鍊被卡住？皮製品表面「甩皮」？「3分鐘愛美麗」教你解決各種在約會時可能遇到的問題。某人氣帆布鞋品牌在全世界只有兩間分店可以客製化鞋款，「東京時尚遊」走訪當中環境優美的吉祥寺分店。「MIT時尚」介紹可愛的人氣手工雙扣零錢包，品牌由一對香港夫婦用心打造。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵] 及 才駿HASHTAG M\u0026G英卓及中銀香港 投資新靈感[粵]
programme.desc: 居港越南人Tracy帶伍倩彤品嚐越南地道檬粉。米紙蝦卷包裹檬粉、香菜等配料，加上秘製花生醬，酸爽開胃；蟹膏番茄湯檬鮮味濃郁，蟹膏蛋餅飽吸湯汁精華。此外，順化牛腱米線湯底鮮甜；斑蘭綠豆糕層次分明，同樣不容錯過。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到荃灣的酒店品嚐豐盛美饌。香烤拼盤包羅羊架、串燒及迷你漢堡包等惹味佳餚；特色下午茶套餐則有鴨肝西多士、芒果拿破崙等鹹甜美點，以及由區內老字號食店供應的馳名糯米糍，滋味十足。.

programme.title: 旅人視角[粵/普]
programme.desc: 祐宏今集沿着捷運路線，尋訪台北的滋味餐廳。韓式咖啡店內，能夠喝到韓國大熱的「鮮奶油糖拿鐵」。此外，不少客人的桌上放着一個烤爐，有何特別用途？深受學生歡迎的甜品店，一款巨型刨冰竟內藏奶凍，充滿驚喜。由舊日式建築物改建而成的和風餐廳，顧客可嘗試以碗泡茶的特別體驗。西門町竟有一間叢林主題西餐廳，在植物環抱下用餐，份外寫意！附近還開設一間人氣「打卡」甜品店，祐宏推介士多啤梨奶昔「紅心皇后」，有多滋味？.

programme.title: 網紅甜卡[粵] 及 好嘢港多啲[粵]
programme.desc: Veronica示範用領巾配襯不同造型，接著帶兩位主持前往一間工作室，嘗試用名牌手袋的廢料及古著布料自製包包，過程殊不簡單！兩位主持造訪號稱巴黎第一的可麗餅店，跟日本裔大廚學造可麗餅，手藝如何？兩人與Veronica再到香薰店選購香薰、按摩兼吃甜品，一次滿足三個願望！Veronica還引領二人參觀時裝展，欣賞香港不同設計師的設計。巴黎之旅尾聲，三人乘船在塞納河上享用晚餐兼賞夜景，分享此行難忘感受？.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 居港泰國人Aimee帶黃嘉雯品嚐泰國家常菜。以蟹肉及肉碎熬煮椰汁咖喱，配搭青瓜、炸鱸魚等同吃，別具風味；燒漢來豬肋骨香辣惹味；南瓜炒蛋層次豐富，九層塔味道突出；鹹甜脆薄餅滋味獨特。施焯日、波波到中環試吃「大熱」美食，包括配初榨橄欖油的乳酪雪糕及自選配料雪葩；蛋撻、黑芝麻及秋梨伯爵茶口味瑪德蓮蛋糕；巴馬臣芝士蒜香扭紋酥及黑芝麻流心麻糬撻；夾着手打和牛漢堡扒的壓烤菠蘿包及辛口蜜糖菠蘿油，款款充滿驚喜。.

programme.title: 下飯江湖4 食色福州[粵/普]
programme.desc: 以福州為主題，通過充滿煙火氣的福州生活，展現這座城市獨特的歷史底蘊與市井風情，觀眾將通過導演鏡頭領略福州最動人的“食色”江湖。.

programme.title: 娛樂新聞報道
programme.desc: 每晚緊貼香港娛樂圈的消息，以至世界各地的影視娛樂新聞，報道藝人最新動態、劇集和電影宣傳、演唱會精華、頒獎禮盛況等，甚至遠赴外地採訪娛樂盛事、追蹤各地影星，專訪觀眾熟悉的歌、影、視紅人，讓大家瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈的動態和最新消息。.

programme.title: 世界第一等[粵/普]
programme.desc: 《世界第一等》探訪世界各地稀奇古怪、駭人聽聞的風土民情，以時下年輕人最喜歡的壯遊行程，結合深度自助旅行的概念，為觀眾送出強大的旅行秘笈。.

programme.title: 按居按揭轉介呈獻:星二代煮飯仔[粵]
programme.desc: 張名雅的兩名兒子Mario、Milo挑戰「煮飯仔」，自信爆棚。行仔領他們外出買餸，兩兄弟與檔販們交流，毫不怯場。回到「煮場」聯手炮製薯仔蛋餅，其間狀況百出；哥哥忍不住頻頻偷吃食材，弟弟則意圖將所有鹽放進蛋液中。兩兄弟削薯皮時更是險象環生，不僅媽媽憂心，行仔還緊張地喝停！接着由三母子合作煮意粉，但這對調皮兄弟下調味料時無視名雅指揮。弟弟切洋蔥「中招」流淚，媽媽想親吻呵護，卻被他在鏡頭前靦腆抗拒…….

programme.title: 點劇成真:降魔的#21[粵][PG]
programme.desc: (大結局)馬季請求有為替他製槍，用來收拾魔，有為覺得馬季的做法危險而拒絕。馬季對芷若的態度變得冷淡，還說以後或許不能再接載她回家，臨別時更輕吻了芷若一下。嘟嘟sir全力緝捕展明，但展明竟自投羅網。展明被押送到法庭門外，馬季急步趕來，突然一陣強風刮起，展明、馬季同時昏倒。原來魔製造出特別的封閉空間，讓展明、馬季互相決鬥…….

programme.title: 設計型空間[粵]
programme.desc: 工業風於2017年繼續流行，設計師如何將這種既粗獷又富空間感的風格，在港式蝸居呈現？陳婉衡暢談理想蝸居構思，竟希望在屋中加設鋼管？.

programme.title: OT無限loop
programme.desc: 每晚深夜，公司仲有邊個未收工？有屋企唔返，咁搏命係愛定係責任？閉路電視全程無間斷直擊，《社畜求生101》主角阿星同阿花捱更抵夜職場血淚史！.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 熱愛旅遊的賈思樂是一名中葡混血兒，遊遍世界多個國家，卻從沒有到訪父親的故鄉葡萄牙，究竟是何原因？及後加入《歡樂今宵》，思樂不時要出埠拍攝，足跡踏過東南亞、歐洲、美加等地。他坦言最愛泰國，除了美食合心意，更是因為人情味濃厚。思樂還分享一次與朋友在當地宵夜時遇見一位漂亮的「女士」，卻被友人「整蠱」的難忘經歷！思樂外遊時亦曾遇不快事，他在巴黎機場因迷路尋求漂亮女生協助，豈料卻遇上騙子，詳情怎樣？.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 藝人賈思樂繼續漫談在世界各地旅行的難忘經歷，他一次和陳法蓉等友人同赴意大利米蘭，偶遇一位態度友善的外國人在法蓉手腕繫上手繩，卻突然要求收取費用。思樂笑稱當時被法蓉的應對嚇了一跳，究竟發生何事？思樂亦認同與朋友一起旅行可看清對方的性格，且聽他細說教他討厭的旅伴類型。思樂即將舉行慈善音樂會，還邀得毛舜筠等六位「星級」女嘉賓獻聲。為求有最好表現，他透露已花了兩個月時間練歌，體能方面又會怎樣鍛練？.

programme.title: 娛樂新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 每晚緊貼香港娛樂圈的消息，以至世界各地的影視娛樂新聞，報道藝人最新動態、劇集和電影宣傳、演唱會精華、頒獎禮盛況等，甚至遠赴外地採訪娛樂盛事、追蹤各地影星，專訪觀眾熟悉的歌、影、視紅人，讓大家瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈的動態和最新消息。.

programme.title: 下飯江湖4 食色福州[粵/普]
programme.desc: 以福州為主題，通過充滿煙火氣的福州生活，展現這座城市獨特的歷史底蘊與市井風情，觀眾將通過導演鏡頭領略福州最動人的“食色”江湖。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 居港泰國人Aimee帶黃嘉雯品嚐泰國家常菜。以蟹肉及肉碎熬煮椰汁咖喱，配搭青瓜、炸鱸魚等同吃，別具風味；燒漢來豬肋骨香辣惹味；南瓜炒蛋層次豐富，九層塔味道突出；鹹甜脆薄餅滋味獨特。施焯日、波波到中環試吃「大熱」美食，包括配初榨橄欖油的乳酪雪糕及自選配料雪葩；蛋撻、黑芝麻及秋梨伯爵茶口味瑪德蓮蛋糕；巴馬臣芝士蒜香扭紋酥及黑芝麻流心麻糬撻；夾着手打和牛漢堡扒的壓烤菠蘿包及辛口蜜糖菠蘿油，款款充滿驚喜。.

programme.title: 網紅甜卡[粵]
programme.desc: Christy、Jessica踏上「整餅」之路，Veronica先替二人裝身，衣著與往訪餐廳主色調「襯到絕」！二人先到藍帶畢業生創辦的甜品店，學造「無花果黑芝麻杏仁撻」；並品嚐外脆內軟的法式甜點「可麗露」。甜品上完美擠花竟得力於黑膠唱片機？兩位主持接著拜訪前五星級酒店甜品師，實習炮製「法式曲奇」，竟然好吃懶做？招牌甜點「雲呢拿撻」的撻皮，講求「快」工出細貨；標準厚度只有3mm，口感百分百香脆！.

programme.title: 按居按揭轉介呈獻:星二代煮飯仔[粵] 及 航向未來[粵]
programme.desc: 「小廚神」Lucy自信廚藝有五星，被母親梁志瑩揭穿僅兩次下廚經驗。Lucy偕妹妹Sucy出外買餸，想煮蒜蓉牛油蘑菇，卻差點買錯冬菇……「小助手」Sucy客串處理食材後要守規回座，反對無效下只好哭着投奔媽媽懷抱。Lucy初次一手包辦烹飪步驟，兌現「五星」功架，母親、妹妹都讚好！母女再煮薑蔥雞翼，女兒們最期待用手撈醃料？Lucy點評母親出品，「頒獎」時刻份外溫馨！加插親子問答，Lucy趣怪奉上表情包。.

programme.title: 娛樂新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 每晚緊貼香港娛樂圈的消息，以至世界各地的影視娛樂新聞，報道藝人最新動態、劇集和電影宣傳、演唱會精華、頒獎禮盛況等，甚至遠赴外地採訪娛樂盛事、追蹤各地影星，專訪觀眾熟悉的歌、影、視紅人，讓大家瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈的動態和最新消息。.

programme.title: 紅色高踭鞋#44[粵/韓][PG] 及 航向未來[粵]
programme.desc: 基錫無法接受珍瑪提分手，珍瑪問基錫可否幫助她復仇，基錫無話可說，只好忍痛接受。珍瑪與賢錫一起去出差，慧彬一直聯絡不上賢錫，沒想到最後接起電話的人是珍瑪，還用視像電話讓她看到賢錫裸身躺在酒店床上的畫面….

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵]
就是愛美麗[粵/普]
programme.desc: 梁以辰、梁嘉琪、袁觀玲教授臉部保濕及身體補水秘訣，告別乾巴巴人生。「愛美麗盲測」測試四款開架式人氣睫毛膏的濃稠度、整體妝感及防水度。「MIT時尚」介紹手工訂製皮鞋，品牌創辦人結合自身經歷，從打板、設計、開發到行銷均一手包辦，並讓客人自行揀選鞋款及皮革、鞋扣、鞋帶等鞋子組件，發揮創意。在原宿竹下通有一間由人氣服飾品牌開設的雜貨店，主打各種可愛、時尚及充滿玩味的小物品，「東京時尚遊」帶觀眾「潮聖」。.

programme.title: 就是愛美麗[粵/普]
programme.desc: 喜迎新春豬年到！新年當然要打扮得漂漂亮亮，充滿喜氣，時尚觀察家關婷玉教你過年時尚穿搭，美肌保養專家林凱鈞則分享豬年開運彩妝術，讓女生在豬年行運又時尚。Coco Chanel女士所創立的高級服飾品牌，是每次巴黎時裝周最矚目的品牌之一，「巴黎時裝周時尚特輯」走訪該品牌以海灘為設計舞台的2019春夏時尚展示秀，並邀請陳柏霖、桂綸鎂及張鈞甯分享看秀感想。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 星廚莫燦霖帶波波到陳佑良師傅主理的餐廳，品嚐懷舊手工粵菜。秘製生醃汁海釣鮮魷爽脆彈牙，醬汁更提鮮；胡椒豬肚鳳吞燕，將燕窩釀入起骨雞殼內，再以豬肚包裹燉製，鮮味層層交融；濃雞汁玻璃大蝦球盡顯精湛刀工，蝦球晶瑩剔透；紅棗皇糕香甜軟糯，層次豐富。施焯日帶陳若思到訪位於尖沙咀的老字號京菜館，品嚐單立文、蘇民峰師傅等名人愛吃的招牌菜，包括叉子燒餅配榨菜肉末、北京填鴨、蝦子鍋塌豆腐及蟹粉芙蓉，盡享京菜風味。.

programme.title: 漫遊森呼吸[粵]
programme.desc: 「登山新手」梁凱晴第一站向難度不易的皇帝殿進發，但走不到十分鐘便「索晒氣」？在天王廟休息站補充體力後，才真正迎來挑戰。凱晴拉着鐵鍊攀登垂直的小岩壁，越過險峻的稜線，終於攻上天王峰！沿西峰出口下山，凱晴來到石碇老街享用「手工豆腐大餐」，再品嚐豆腐蛋糕、豆腐雪糕，先算滿足。蔥油餅DIY體驗由下田拔蔥、搓粉糰、下鑊煎香一手包辦，滋味如何？凱晴還試吃流水麵線，手快有手慢無！遊覽石碇，更不可錯過千島湖美景。.

programme.title: 鎮鄉之寶[粵/普]
programme.desc: 蠔是台灣嘉義縣東石鄉的鎮鄉之寶，這裡大約八成鄉民都直接或間接參與蠔業養殖的工作。本集主持就帶大家來了解蠔農的日常工作是什麼；蠔業對環境帶來什麼影響；當地居民又如何實現家鄉的永續發展呢？.

programme.title: 關注關注組[粵]
programme.desc: 芫荽又被稱為香菜，不少人對其愛恨分明，坊間更有為「芫荽控」推出特別美食。有指芫荽好處多，除了進食可降血壓之外，用來洗澡還有助舒緩皮膚問題？「日行」本身都對芫荽不太喜愛，外出食好「荽」後可會改觀？他們分別買來融入芫荽的特飲、漢堡、車仔麵與滑蛋三文治，對於美味之選，二人意見分歧？日行這次準備的食品中，粉絲杯麵、魚肉燒賣都被大家投訴芫荽味不足。慧儀提到「爆荽千層蛋糕」的味道像藍芝士，十郎更覺得被整蠱！.

programme.title: 網紅甜卡[粵]
programme.desc: 古著是名牌以外的另類選擇，Christy、Jessica隨Veronica參觀巴黎古著專門店，穿出跨時代經典時尚，造型亮眼！三人隨即往「人氣」劇集取景地朝聖，在吊刑廣場紅色酒館、萬神殿瘋狂打卡，與當地劇迷交流；如何利用建築物的特色，拍出具電影感的美照？兩位主持另相約美食導遊訪尋隱世甜點、學捲牛角包，店主兼甜品師開店純因友情？靈感來自單車的招牌甜點、榮登食譜書封面的真正「千層」酥，「味」力沒法擋！.

programme.title: 就是愛美麗[粵/普]
programme.desc: 梁以辰、梁嘉琪、袁觀玲教授臉部保濕及身體補水秘訣，告別乾巴巴人生。「愛美麗盲測」測試四款開架式人氣睫毛膏的濃稠度、整體妝感及防水度。「MIT時尚」介紹手工訂製皮鞋，品牌創辦人結合自身經歷，從打板、設計、開發到行銷均一手包辦，並讓客人自行揀選鞋款及皮革、鞋扣、鞋帶等鞋子組件，發揮創意。在原宿竹下通有一間由人氣服飾品牌開設的雜貨店，主打各種可愛、時尚及充滿玩味的小物品，「東京時尚遊」帶觀眾「潮聖」。.

programme.title: 京都畫報[粵/日]
programme.desc: 趁著藝術之秋，常盤貴子在作庭家小川勝章的導賞下遊覽多個庭園。涉成園佈局精巧，在指定位置可以看見獨特美景，室內更有版畫家棟方志功的作品。白沙村莊由畫家橋本關雪親自設計，環境饒富詩意。.

programme.title: OT無限loop
programme.desc: 每晚深夜，公司仲有邊個未收工？有屋企唔返，咁搏命係愛定係責任？閉路電視全程無間斷直擊，《社畜求生101》主角阿星同阿花捱更抵夜職場血淚史！.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 歌手黎曉陽、黃進林與演員方泳琳都有一個演藝夢，三位「九十後」藝人今集同來細說追夢歷程。曉陽、進林均曾到街頭賣唱，揚言各有殺手鐧，總可吸引途人駐足欣賞。曉陽還難忘一次在蘭桂坊演唱，竟見女觀眾興奮脫衣！「籃球女神」琳琳於網絡爆紅當上KOL，繼而踏足娛樂圈。她現時積極進修演技，以成為出色演員為目標。演藝路上難免遇到挫敗，三人如何認清自己，堅定前行？曉陽並分享何謂真正的快樂，更希望透過作品感動別人。.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 盂蘭勝會上的神功戲，究竟為誰而演？粵劇名伶蓋鳴暉提到盂蘭節神功戲專為敬拜神靈，順道為大家提供娛樂。台板經驗豐富的她坦言不敢接演這類劇目，擔心誤犯禁忌！戲棚內有不少傳統習俗與規矩，戲班人員不單需供奉華光先師，演出神功戲前的拜祭流程、祭品選擇、舞台選址等都有學問。鳴暉還強調戲班中人的戲箱不可亂踢，也不要隨便問候他們，詳情怎樣？有指靈體會依附到昆蟲上，鳴暉亦曾在演出時被昆蟲滋擾，卻有「禮貌」方法應對！.

programme.title: 女生素舍[粵]
programme.desc: Fine Dining常會用不同醬汁來提升食物的味道，「全素」廚師Pamela與拍檔Gillian和Michelle，今次就來炮製兩道配上惹味醬汁的美食。首先是「蓮藕餅配羅望子忌廉醬」，羅望子有酸豆之稱，Pam用什麼中和它的酸味？炸得香脆的蓮藕餅內有大豆纖維、甘筍碎等餡料，配上酸甜醬汁，非常開胃！另一道甜品「黑醋士多啤梨酥餅」，Pam加了什麼法寶令酥餅格外鬆脆？她又為何會想到用黑醋醬來配士多啤梨？.

programme.title: Christian In Paris[粵]
programme.desc: 除了電視送飯，改以凱旋門送飯或會更滋味。尚友帶家人來到可遠望凱旋門的餐廳，品嚐蝸牛與田雞兩款法式手工菜，仔仔一試隨即愛上。尚友為子女安排了法式餐桌禮儀課，原來飲杯水的手勢都有要求。行逛位於巴黎第十二區的文森森林，林裡有一間供應地中海菜的沙灘主題餐廳。尚友入座用餐，大讚哈蜜瓜菲達芝士沙律的配搭夠滋味。返回廚房，尚友用田螺替代蝸牛，釀進巨型的貝殼粉中，再配上香煎田雞，成為一道創新的法國料理。.

programme.title: Canned Mackerel Heads to Space
programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程.

programme.title: Private Banker
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突.

programme.title: The Vendetta of An
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清.
